### SC-§37.1 ⭐⭐ **DERIVE A PROBE IN THE ⛔ PRECISION OF THE THING IT WILL BE ⛔ COMPARED AGAINST** (added 2026-09-02; bought by a test that measured itself wrong for two commits — `TASK-853`, endorsed on its own merits by `qa/TASK-854.md` §4 ruling 3)

- ⛔ **THE RULE:** a test probe's arithmetic is chosen by the ⛔ **COMPARAND**, ⛔ not by "more precision is better". ⭐ **A value that will be compared against `State.End` / `ClimbDirection` (⛔ doubles) is derived in ⛔ DOUBLE; a value that will be compared against a clamp at `State.LengthUU` (⛔ a float) is ⛔ float-derived, ⛔ deliberately.** ⇒ ⛔ **"fix the float casts" is the ⛔ WRONG generalisation and a sweep on that basis is ⛔ scope creep in both directions.**
- ⛔⛔ **AND WHERE IT BITES, ⛔ stated as the shape rather than as a site: ⛔ ANY PROBE FEEDING AN ⛔ EXACT SIGN TEST** (`dot(...) <= 0`, `==`, `IsZero`). ⛔ **Elsewhere — subtractions, bounds, tolerances — a `5e-05` is ⛔ swamped and the precision choice is ⛔ immaterial.** ⭐ **The one probe that mattered here was the one whose result was ⛔ a SIGN.**
- ⚠️⭐ **THE LATENT, ⛔ GEOMETRY-GATED TRAP — ⛔ recorded because it is ⛔ real and ⛔ currently unreachable, which is ⛔ exactly the kind of thing that gets discovered by a playtest:** a float/double disagreement flips a guarded normalise only when `|ΔL| ≥ 1e-4` (so `SquareSum ≥ UE_SMALL_NUMBER = 1e-8`). ⛔ **Max float32 error at `L ∈ [1024, 2048)` is ½ ULP = `6.10e-05` ⇒ ⛔ IMPOSSIBLE below a ⛔ 2,048 uu line. ⚠️ At `L ∈ [2048, 4096)` it is `1.22e-04` ⇒ ⛔ POSSIBLE, for ~18% of lengths.** ⇒ ⛔ **a ladder or climb line longer than ⛔ 2,048 uu re-opens this class.**
- ⛔⛔ **WHAT MUST ⛔ NEVER BE WRITTEN INTO THIS SECTION, ⛔ AND WHY THE PROHIBITION IS PART OF THE LAW:** the claim *"the `SteerDirection` sibling must stay float-derived ⛔ or a green row goes red"* is ⛔ **MEASURED FALSE** — `GetSafeNormal`'s `SquareSum < Tolerance` branch returns ZeroVector and the `Steer.IsZero()` fallback returns `Along`, so the sample ⛔ still agrees. ⛔ **The number that "proved" it came from an ⛔ UNGUARDED normalise the shipped code does ⛔ not perform.** ⇒ ⚖️ *⛔ `SC-§38` cl. 4 in miniature: ⛔ a law describing BEHAVIOUR rots silently and ⛔ instructs the next task. ⭐ The ⛔ conclusion (⛔ change none of the six) was ⛔ right; ⛔ the evidence was ⛔ wrong; ⛔ the evidence is what a future reader would have ⛔ inherited.*

### SC-§38 ⛔⛔⛔ **A `file:line` IN A LAW IS A ⛔ DATED ANNOTATION. ⭐ THE ⛔ SYMBOL IS THE KEY. — THE CITATION-ROT LAW** (added 2026-09-03; bought by `WITCH-§3a` rotting **within one hour of being written**, caught by `TASK-847`)

> ### ⚖️⭐⭐ **THREE LAWS DRIFTED FROM THE CODE THEY DESCRIBE ⛔ IN A SINGLE DAY. ⛔ THAT IS NOT THREE MISTAKES — ⛔ IT IS ⛔ ONE LAW-SHAPE DEFECT, AND THIS SECTION IS THE TRIPWIRE.**

⛔ **THE MEASURED EVIDENCE, 2026-09-03, ⛔ all three found by gates rather than by a reader:**
1. ⛔ **`WITCH-§3a`'s Sapper row** — written as `SummonedUnit.cpp:4209`; **`TASK-828` edited that file in parallel** and the blast moved to **`:4212`**, with `4209` becoming a ⛔ **comment line**. (`:2418`→`:2419`, `:4227`→`:4230`. ⭐ `AncientGround.cpp:233` and `MinerUnit.cpp:514` were ⛔ exact — ⛔ *the drift is not uniform, so it cannot be corrected by an offset; ⛔ it must be re-measured per row.*)
2. ⛔ **`FOG-§7`'s site table** — the same five vision sites, already off by the same edit.
3. ⛔ **`FOG-§7` row 4** — recorded the cheat lane as *"exempt ⛔ BY NAME"* while the shipped diff ⛔ **ROUTES** it. ⚠️⚠️ **That one is worse than a stale number: a future task honouring the table would have ⛔ RESTORED a second enumeration and ⛔ failed the `WITCH-§1` grep gate ⛔ in order to obey the law.**

1. ✅⭐⭐ **THE RULE: any law that points at code points with a ⛔ SYMBOL — a class, a function, a quoted expression — and the `file:line` rides ⛔ behind it as an ⛔ italic, ⛔ DATED annotation.** ⛔ **A row that carries ⛔ only a line number is ⛔ not shippable law.** ⭐ **A quoted expression makes the citation ⛔ SELF-CORRECTING: when the number and the symbol disagree, the ⛔ NUMBER is wrong ⛔ by construction.**
2. ⛔⛔ **CONSUMERS ⛔ LOCATE BY SYMBOL; GATES ⛔ VERIFY BY SYMBOL.** ⛔ **A gate that checks a line number is checking the ⛔ wrong thing — it will report ⛔ ordinary parallel work as a ⛔ defect and will ⛔ miss a trap that genuinely moved class.**
3. ⛔⛔ **THE TRIPWIRE, AND IT IS THE CLAUSE WITH TEETH: ⛔ WHEN A TASK EDITS A FILE THAT A LAW CITES, THE ⛔ CITING LAW'S FACTS ARE ⛔ RE-MEASURED ⛔ IN THAT TASK'S GATE.** ⇒ ⛔ **the gate over a diff owns the ⛔ laws the diff invalidated**, ⛔ not merely the diff. ⭐ *This is the operational half of the standing rule that ⛔ **every supporting fact in a law is itself law and is re-measured when the law is touched** — that rule fires when the ⛔ LAW moves; ⛔ this one fires when the ⛔ CODE moves, ⛔ which is the far more common direction.*
4. 📌 **AND THE ⛔ SHARPEST TELL, from instance 3: ⛔ a law that describes ⛔ BEHAVIOUR (*"exempt by name"* / *"routed"*) rots ⛔ SILENTLY and ⛔ instructs the next task to ⛔ re-introduce the defect.** ⇒ ⛔ **a ruling that a diff ⛔ overturns must be ⛔ reworded in the ⛔ same sitting the diff passes its gate — ⛔ never left as a *"known stale"* row.**
5. ⚖️ **SCOPE — ⛔ this does ⛔ NOT ban line numbers.** ⭐ They are genuinely useful and they are ⛔ how a reader finds a thing in a 4,000-line file. ⛔ **It bans a line number ⛔ ALONE, and it bans ⛔ TRUSTING one.** ⛔ It binds `CONVENTIONS.md`, ⛔ task `spec:` blocks and ⛔ QA gate rows — ⛔ not handoffs, which are ⛔ snapshots of a moment ⛔ by definition.
6. ⛔⛔⭐ **AND THE ⛔ FOURTH DRIFT OF THE SAME DAY SAYS WHERE ELSE THIS LIVES, ⛔ AND IT IS ⛔ NOT IN A FILE: ⛔ AN ⛔ ORCHESTRATOR DISPATCH PROMPT CARRIES THE ⛔ IDENTICAL DEFECT.** ⛔ **`RequiredIds[]` was relayed to ⛔ TWO agents as `SiegeControlsHelpTest.cpp:227`; it is ⛔ actually at `:243-255`.** ⭐ **Nothing broke — the array was ⛔ unedited, so the automatic-fail condition ⛔ never fired and ⛔ no decision rode the bad number — ⭐ and the orchestrator ⛔ reported it against itself, ⛔ which is the behaviour this clause exists to keep.** ⇒ ⛔ **a dispatch prompt states the ⛔ SYMBOL (`RequiredIds[]`, `ComposeDetailContent`, *the `if (Node->TryRegisterArrivedMiner(this))` arm*) and the line ⛔ only as a hint.** ⚖️ *⛔ A prompt is the ⛔ shortest-lived document in the pipeline and the ⛔ only one nobody re-reads — ⛔ which makes it the ⛔ worst place to put a coordinate and the ⛔ best place to put a name.*
7. ⛔⛔⭐ **AND THE ⛔ FIFTH DRIFT OF THE SAME DAY WENT ⛔ ONE LEVEL DEEPER THAN CLAUSE 6 AND HAS ITS ⛔ OWN SECTION: ⛔ IT WAS ⛔ NOT A COORDINATE THAT ROTTED, IT WAS A ⛔ FACT THAT WAS ⛔ NEVER TRUE — and it was carried by a ⛔ QA VERDICT and a ⛔ MANAGER RELAY, ⛔ the two channels everyone downstream reads as ⛔ settled.** ⇒ ⛔ **`SC-§40`.** ⚖️ *⛔ Clause 6 says a prompt must carry a ⛔ SYMBOL instead of a number. ⛔ `SC-§40` says a prompt must carry a ⛔ PROVENANCE instead of a verdict.*
8. ⛔⛔⭐⭐ **CLAUSE 8 — ⛔ THE SAME DEFECT WEARING A DIFFERENT COAT: ⛔ A ⛔ FIGURE QUOTED IN PROSE IS A ⛔ DATED ANNOTATION. ⭐ THE ⛔ EXPRESSION IT WAS COMPUTED FROM IS THE ⛔ KEY.** (added 2026-09-02, proposed by `qa/TASK-854.md` §8 and ⛔ adopted; ⛔ it is ⛔ not a new law, it is ⛔ this one applied to ⛔ numbers rather than to ⛔ coordinates)
   - ✅ **THE RULE: ⛔ when a document's PROSE and the ⛔ CODE SNIPPET beside it disagree, ⛔ THE SNIPPET IS ⛔ NORMATIVE and the ⛔ NUMBER is the thing that rotted.** ⇒ ⛔ **a recommendation that quotes a value ⛔ states the expression that produces it, and a ⛔ CONSUMER RE-DERIVES rather than relays.**
   - ⛔⛔⭐⭐ **A ⛔ FOURTH, ⛔ ADDED THE SAME EVENING (`qa/TASK-865.md` WARN-1), AND IT IS A ⛔ NEW SUB-SHAPE WORTH ITS OWN NAME: ⛔ A ⛔ NUMBER THAT WAS ⛔ RIGHT ⛔ ABOUT THE WRONG THING.**
     - ⛔ `concept_generate.py`'s threshold ledger claims `MIN_LUMA_STDDEV` 0.010 sits ⛔ *"~3.5× above the worst degenerate"* and that the floors therefore have *"a ⛔ comparable margin against ⛔ BOTH failure directions"*. ⛔ **Re-derived from the table printed ⛔ IMMEDIATELY ABOVE IT: it is ⛔ 1.45× (⛔ worst degenerate ⛔ 0.0069).** ⇒ ⛔ **the sentence is ⛔ FALSE: ⛔ 1.45× one way, ⛔ 8.4× the other.**
     - ⭐⭐ **THE SUB-SHAPE: ⛔ `3.5×` IS A ⛔ REAL, ⛔ CORRECTLY-COMPUTED NUMBER — ⛔ it is the margin ⛔ BELOW THE WORST ⛔ LEGITIMATE-DARK CASE (0.035). ⛔ It was attached to the ⛔ OTHER SIDE OF THE GAP.** ⇒ ⛔⛔ **this is ⛔ WORSE than a stale figure, because ⛔ recomputing the number ⛔ REPRODUCES IT — ⛔ only recomputing it ⛔ AGAINST THE CLAIM catches it.** ✅ **THE RULE THIS ADDS: ⛔ re-derive the ⛔ NUMBER ⛔ AND the ⛔ DIRECTION. ⛔ A margin is ⛔ meaningless without the ⛔ side it is measured from.**
     - ⚖️ **AND THE ⛔ CONSEQUENCE-SCOPING, ⛔ because the gate did it right: ⛔ the thresholds themselves were ruled ⛔ DEFENSIBLE** (⛔ the black frame is rejected ⛔ TWICE OVER; `no-lit-content` at ⛔ 3.9× is the ⛔ load-bearing check, `no-structure` merely ⛔ supporting) ⇒ ⛔ **the ⛔ PROSE was fixed and the ⛔ NUMBERS were ⛔ explicitly forbidden from moving** (`TASK-879` item 2b). ⭐ *⛔ A false claim about a defensible value is a ⛔ DOCUMENTATION defect; ⛔ "fixing" the value would have been a ⛔ behaviour change with ⛔ no defect behind it.*
     - ⭐ **THE STRUCTURAL CAUSE, ⛔ and it is the ⛔ fixable part: ⛔ the tool's own test printed ⛔ ONLY the ⛔ CORPUS-side margin — ⛔ i.e. ⛔ ONLY the half that ⛔ looks generous.** ⇒ ⛔ **the comment rotted because the ⛔ INSTRUMENT NEVER PRINTED THE ⛔ DAMNING HALF.** ✅ **When a document quotes a margin, the ⛔ instrument prints ⛔ BOTH SIDES ⛔ or the prose will drift toward the ⛔ flattering one.**
   - ⛔ **THE MEASURED EVIDENCE — ⛔ FOUR IN ONE EVENING, ⛔ all the same shape, ⛔ and ⛔ EVERY ONE was right in the snippet and wrong in the sentence:** ⛔ (1) `-9.999529e-01` travelled ⛔ report → ⛔ dispatch → ⛔ nearly into a handoff (the shipped value is `-1.000000e+00`; ⛔ the quoted figure was `L_float + 1.0`) — ⛔ caught ⛔ only because the implementer ⛔ re-derived · ⛔ (2) `306/306` reached ⛔ THREE records as a ⛔ pass while the suite had gone ⛔ UNEXECUTED for ⛔ two commits (`TL-§5c`) · ⛔ (3) a figure that was ⛔ never derivable from the shipped code ⛔ at all reached a ⛔ board row and a ⛔ `names:` block ⛔ within the hour (`SC-§37.1`'s prohibition) · ⭐ **⛔ (4) a ⛔ `3.5×` margin that was ⛔ correctly computed ⛔ about the ⛔ WRONG SIDE OF THE GAP travelled into a ⛔ source comment ⛔ AND a handoff (⛔ the sub-shape above; ⛔ truth: ⛔ 1.45×)** — ⛔ **and note it reached ⛔ TWO records, ⛔ one of them ⛔ the code itself, ⛔ which is where the next editor will ⛔ re-tune from.**
   - ⚠️⭐ **AND THE SCORING, ⛔ stated honestly because it is the ⛔ operational point: ⛔ all ⛔ FOUR were caught by the ⛔ NEXT AGENT RE-DERIVING — ⛔ never by the writer, and ⛔ never by a gate reading for style.** ⭐⭐ **The ⛔ fourth is the ⛔ sharpest instance: it was caught by a gate that ⛔ recomputed a margin it had ⛔ no reason to doubt, ⛔ from a table printed ⛔ two lines above the false sentence.** ⭐ **The ⛔ only two figures that survived contact were the ⛔ two somebody ⛔ recomputed.** ⇒ ⛔ **the pipeline works ⛔ because each stage ⛔ refuses to relay; ⛔ this clause makes that refusal ⛔ the rule rather than the ⛔ habit of whoever happened to be careful.**

### SC-§38a ⛔⛔⛔ **`Grep` ⛔ LOCATES; IT DOES ⛔ NOT ⛔ QUOTE. ⭐ `Read` IS ⛔ AUTHORITATIVE FOR ⛔ ANY CHARACTER-EXACT CLAIM.** (added 2026-09-04; bought by `qa/TASK-996.md`, which ⛔ NEARLY FILED A FALSE BLOCKER, and ⛔ corroborated independently the same session)

- ⛔⛔ **MEASURED, ⛔ TWICE, ⛔ INDEPENDENTLY: the `Grep` tool ⛔ MISRENDERS COMMENT DELIMITERS.** ⛔ On `SiegeFogStatics.h:247`/`:304` it printed `//` as `\`; on `SummonedUnit.h:1037` it printed `/**` as `\**`. ⛔ **`Read` shows the ⛔ correct characters in both.**
- ⇒ ⛔⛔ **THE FAILURE MODE IS ⛔ SPECIFIC AND ⛔ EXPENSIVE: a mangled delimiter reads as a ⛔ COMPILE-BREAKING STRAY TOKEN in a shipped header** ⇒ ⛔ **an agent files a ⛔ BLOCKER against ⛔ correct code — and in the live case, against a file ⛔ ANOTHER AGENT WAS ACTIVELY EDITING, which would have sent the lane hunting a ⛔ phantom defect in a ⛔ moving file.**
- ⛔ **THE LAW: ⛔ `Grep` is for ⛔ FINDING (⛔ which files, ⛔ which lines, ⛔ how many). ⛔ THE MOMENT A CLAIM DEPENDS ON THE ⛔ EXACT CHARACTERS — ⛔ a syntax defect, ⛔ a delimiter, ⛔ a quoted string, ⛔ a literal's precision — ⛔ `Read` THE LINE BEFORE YOU ASSERT IT.**
- ⭐ **SAME FAMILY AS `SC-§38`: ⛔ that law says the ⛔ LINE NUMBER is not the key; ⛔ this one says the ⛔ RENDERED TEXT is not the source.** ⛔ **Both are *"your instrument is not the artefact"*, and ⛔ this one has ⛔ already produced a near-miss.**
- ⚖️ ***⛔ A ⛔ WRONG FAIL AGAINST ⛔ CORRECT CODE IS THE ⛔ EXPENSIVE ERROR*** (`SC-§59` cl. 5) — ⛔ **and a tooling artefact is the ⛔ hardest kind to argue with, because the reviewer is ⛔ looking right at it.**

### SC-§39 ⛔⛔ **A BINARY PROBE NEEDS A ⛔ POSITIVE CONTROL, OR IT ⛔ CANNOT DISTINGUISH *"ABSENT"* FROM *"UNREADABLE"*** (added 2026-09-03; bought and ⛔ self-caught by build-master on `TASK-824`)

- ⛔ **THE MEASURED EVENT:** the `TASK-824` compile gate needed to answer *"is `GetSlotKeyLabel` in the built DLL?"*. ⛔ **A plain `grep` on the binary returned ⛔ ZERO — ⛔ and it returned ⛔ ZERO for the ⛔ CONTROL SYMBOL TOO**, i.e. the instrument was ⛔ blind, ⛔ not the symbol absent. ⭐⭐ **The build-master caught its own flaw ⛔ with its own control and ⛔ re-ran through the DLL's ⛔ name table**, where the ⛔ seven sibling `Siegebound|UI` UFUNCTIONs are ⛔ present and `GetSlotKeyLabel` is ⛔ absent — ⭐ **an independent instrument ⛔ reproducing `TASK-808`'s palette measurement exactly.**
- ✅ **THE RULE: ⛔ every absence claim drawn from a binary, a log, a packaged build or any opaque artefact ⛔ ships with the ⛔ POSITIVE CONTROL that proves the instrument could have ⛔ SEEN the thing.** ⛔ **"I searched and found nothing" is ⛔ not evidence; ⛔ "I searched, found the seven siblings, and did not find this one" ⛔ IS.**
- ⚖️ *Same family as `SHIP-§9` (⛔ validate a gate against the ⛔ FAILURE it detects) and as the standing ⛔ **"a success return is not evidence"** — ⭐ here the ⛔ NULL result is the one that lies, and it lies ⛔ in the reassuring direction ⛔ only half the time: ⛔ a blind grep can ⛔ equally report a symbol ⛔ absent that is ⛔ present.*
- ⛔⛔⭐⭐ **AMENDED 2026-09-02 — ⛔ THE HOUSE HELPER IS ⛔ ITSELF A BLIND INSTRUMENT, ⛔ AND THIS ONE IS ⛔ WORSE THAN A BAD GREP BECAUSE IT IS ⛔ SHARED, ⛔ TRUSTED AND ⛔ INVISIBLE** (measured by `TASK-829`): ⛔ **`CountOccurrencesInCode` ⛔ SKIPS ANY LINE WHOSE ⛔ TRIMMED FORM STARTS WITH `/*`.** ⇒ ⛔⛔ **A GUARD WRITTEN ⛔ ONE-ARGUMENT-PER-LINE — ⛔ exactly the shape the ⛔ named-argument-comment guard takes (`/*ViewerTeam=*/`, `/*TargetTeam=*/`) — IS ⛔ INVISIBLE TO THE ⛔ VERY TEST ENFORCING IT.** ⭐ **The test goes ⛔ GREEN by ⛔ not seeing the thing it is looking for**, which is the ⛔ single worst failure mode a presence-check can have.
  - ✅ **THE RULE: ⛔ a test that counts occurrences in source ⛔ declares its ⛔ SKIP RULES, and ⛔ ships a ⛔ POSITIVE CONTROL written in the ⛔ SAME FORMATTING as the thing it guards.** ⛔ **A control on one line proves ⛔ nothing about a guard on four.**
  - ⚖️ *⛔ Third blind instrument in one evening — ⛔ the DLL grep (this section's origin), ⛔ the bare `^IMPLEMENT_` file-count (`TL-§5b`), ⛔ and now the house helper. ⭐ **The pattern: ⛔ every one was a ⛔ NULL/ZERO result trusted as a ⛔ measurement**, and ⛔ every one was caught by somebody ⛔ asking the instrument a question it should have answered ⛔ YES to.*
  - ⛔⛔⭐ **AND THE ⛔ MIRROR IMAGE, MEASURED BY `TASK-851` ⛔ WITHIN THE HOUR — ⛔ THE SKIP RULE CUTS ⛔ BOTH WAYS AND THE SECOND EDGE IS ⛔ NOT SYMMETRIC WITH THE FIRST:** ⛔ **a leading `/*` ⛔ HIDES A REAL HIT** (the clause above) — ⛔ **a ⛔ TRAILING `//` comment on a ⛔ CODE line ⛔ MANUFACTURES A FALSE ONE.** ⛔ Measured case: an `#include` whose ⛔ trailing `// …` names the symbol sits on a ⛔ code line, ⛔ survives every skip rule, and a ⛔ bare-token needle reads **4** where the truth is **3**. ⇒ ⛔ **A COUNT-BASED GUARD HAS ⛔ TWO FAILURE DIRECTIONS AND A ⛔ SINGLE POSITIVE CONTROL ONLY PROVES ⛔ ONE OF THEM.** ✅ **THE RULE: ⛔ pin the needle to a ⛔ CALL SHAPE (`Symbol(`), ⛔ never a bare token, and ⛔ state which of the two directions your control exercised.** ⚖️ *⛔ The false-positive edge is the ⛔ more dangerous one to inherit: ⛔ a guard that over-counts goes ⛔ RED for a reason that ⛔ is not in the diff, and the ⛔ obvious "fix" is to ⛔ loosen the guard.*
- ⛔⛔⭐⭐ **AMENDED 2026-09-14 — ⛔ THE INSTRUMENT CAN BE ⛔ ABSENT FROM THE SHELL THAT RUNS IT, AND A ⛔ MISSING INSTRUMENT REPORTS ⛔ ZERO IN THE SAME VOICE AS A CLEAN TREE** (measured by `TASK-1266`, `handoffs/TASK-1266-buildmaster.md` §5 item 1; boarded as `TASK-1278`): in this environment `rg` is a shell FUNCTION delegating to `claude.exe`'s bundled ripgrep 14.1.1, ⛔ not a PATH binary — ⛔ invisible to a child `bash script.sh`. ⛔ **`TASK-1266`'s FIRST run reported 0 files / 0 lines on ALL EIGHT patterns** — a false-clean credential census: `wc -l` counted an empty output file and every number was a plausible zero. ⛔ The only tells were `rg: command not found` on STDERR (seen only because the `.err` files were opened) and pattern (6) reading **0** on a file KNOWN to hold an `AnonKey=` line. ✅ **THE RULE: a census that reports ZERO ⛔ FIRST runs its instrument against a KNOWN POSITIVE and ⛔ reads stderr.** The standing control for the credential census is pattern (6) `^AnonKey=\S` on `Config/SiegeCloudDev.ini` = **1** — the file is ⛔ never opened, only COUNTED (`ACC-§11`); a control reading 0 means the instrument is blind, ⛔ not the tree clean. Fix, in the recipe: `export -f rg` before any child shell (`ACC-§11`'s amendment of the same date, cl. (iv)). ⚖️ *Same family as this section's origin rule — the positive control that separates "absent" from "unreadable" — ⭐ here the unreadable thing was the ⛔ INSTRUMENT ITSELF. `SC-§105`'s "a recipe is published by someone who ran it" extends to "…in the SHELL the recipe names": a recipe correct in the parent shell and silently empty in the child is `SC-§105`'s complete-looking-and-incomplete shape one level down. `SC-§101`: once the instrument was proven, the census found two hits BEYOND the expected set and ⛔ STOPPED rather than classify them — the ruling came from the manager on the `TASK-1266` row, not from the instrument.*
- 🚨⛔⛔⭐⭐⭐ **AMENDED 2026-09-17 — ⛔ THIS SECTION'S OWN PRESCRIBED SECRET PIN IS ⛔ DEFECTIVE, AND IT IS `SC-§119` cl. 8 SEEN FROM THE ⛔ OTHER SIDE: ⛔ AN *ABSENCE* PIN ⛔ CANNOT RETURN ZERO WHEN THE CORPUS ⛔ LEGITIMATELY CONTAINS THE TOKEN.** (measured by `TASK-1293`'s build-master host, 2026-09-17; written by the manager the same day; marker `SC-39-SHAPED-PIN-NOT-LITERAL`)
  - ⛔ **THE MEASURED EVENT:** the host ran the literal 3-character JWT-prefix pin that this section — and ⛔ every commit row on this board — prescribes, and it did ⛔ **NOT return 0**: **8** hits on `CONVENTIONS.md`, **27** on `TASKBOARD.md`. ⭐⭐ **It neither waved them through nor raised a false STOP — it ⛔ MEASURED**, which is the behaviour this whole section exists to buy. **Two causes, ⛔ neither a credential:** **(a) 12 of 37** are the prefix landing ⛔ **BY CHANCE INSIDE `WasInputKeyJustPressed`** ⇒ ⛔ a bare literal can ⛔ NEVER return 0 on ⛔ any file in this project that discusses Enhanced Input; **(b) the other 25** are ⛔ **THE PIN'S OWN NAME, QUOTED IN THE LAW AND BOARD PROSE THAT PRESCRIBES IT** — `TASK-1282` and `TASK-1292` both hit this and ⛔ dodged it by instinct, writing "JWT-prefix" instead of the literal.
  - ✅ **HOW IT WAS SETTLED — a ⛔ FIRING POSITIVE CONTROL, which is this section's own rule applied to itself:** shaped pattern `<JWT-prefix>[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}` = **12**, ⛔ every one the literal `…ustPressed`; ⛔ credential-shaped bodies **0**; `AnonKey=`value **0**; `DbPassword=`value **0**; `hf_`+body **0**; and the delta `CONVENTIONS.md` HEAD **8** → staged **8**, ⛔ **ZERO NEW** ⇒ ⛔ no secret in the commit, ⛔ stated with an account rather than with a number.
  - ✅ **THE RULE, THREE PARTS, ⛔ all binding on every 5c commit:** **(1) THE PIN IS ⛔ SHAPED, ⛔ NEVER LITERAL** — `<JWT-prefix>[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}` plus the named-key pins (`AnonKey=`value · `DbPassword=`value · `hf_`+body), ⛔ each with a ⛔ FIRING positive control (this section's origin rule: ⛔ prove the instrument could have SEEN it). **(2) REPORT THE ⛔ HEAD→STAGED ⛔ DELTA, ⛔ NEVER AN ABSOLUTE COUNT** — in a corpus that ⛔ legitimately holds the token, an absolute count is ⛔ meaningless and the ⛔ only question that matters is *"did ⛔ THIS commit add one?"*. **(3) ⛔ NEVER WRITE THE LITERAL PREFIX INTO PROSE THAT WILL LATER BE GREPPED** — say ⛔ "JWT-prefix". ⛔ A law that ⛔ contaminates its own corpus is an instrument ⛔ arguing with itself.
  - 📌 **THE COLLISION, RECORDED ⛔ BY NAME so the next host does ⛔ not rediscover it at 2 a.m. under a commit deadline: the 3-character JWT prefix is a ⛔ SUBSTRING OF `WasInputKeyJustPressed`.** ⛔ Any file in this project that discusses Enhanced Input ⛔ WILL hit it.
  - ⚖️ **KINSHIP — and it is the ⛔ whole point.** `SC-§119` cl. 8: a ⛔ **PRESENCE** pin ⛔ cannot detect a ⛔ FALSE STATEMENT that contains the pinned token. Here: an ⛔ **ABSENCE** pin ⛔ cannot return ⛔ ZERO when the corpus ⛔ legitimately contains it. ⇒ ⚖️ ***⛔ SAME ROOT, ⛔ BOTH DIRECTIONS: ⛔ THE PIN MEASURES THE ⛔ TOKEN, ⛔ NOT THE CLAIM.*** ⛔ Presence-shape: the token is there and the ⛔ sentence is false. ⛔ Absence-shape: the token is there and ⛔ no secret is. ⛔ Both pass — or both stop — on a fact ⛔ nobody was asking about.

#### SC-§39.1 ⛔⛔⛔ **PROMOTED 2026-09-02 — *"A SUCCESS RETURN IS NOT EVIDENCE"* NOW BINDS ⛔ TOOL AUTHORSHIP, ⛔ NOT MERELY TOOL USE. ⛔ FOUR BLIND INSTRUMENTS IN ⛔ ONE EVENING IS A ⛔ PATTERN, ⛔ NOT A RUN OF BAD LUCK.**

⛔ **THE FOURTH, and it is the one that ⛔ forced the promotion because it is the ⛔ only one we ⛔ WROTE OURSELVES:** ⛔ **`Tools/ArtPipeline/concept_generate.py` reports `SUCCESS` on a ⛔ FULLY BLACK FRAME and ⛔ writes it to disk** (measured `TASK-833` §9: a ⛔ 12,444-byte "successful" 1024×1024 PNG, `mean` 0.01, ⛔ 100% near-black, vs ~800 KB for a real roll). ⛔ **Reproducible, ⛔ not transient — ⛔ seed 71031 went black ⛔ TWICE on identical input.** ⛔ **And its `--force` is ⛔ DESTRUCTIVE: the black frame ⛔ OVERWROTE a good roll.**

📌 **THE FOUR, ⛔ named together because the ⛔ family is the finding:** ⛔ the invalid binary grep · ⛔ `CountOccurrencesInCode`'s `/*` skip · ⛔ `save_asset` returning `true` while writing nothing · ⛔ `concept_generate.py`'s black frame. ⭐⭐ **THE FIRST THREE WERE INSTRUMENTS WE ⛔ USED. ⛔ THE FOURTH IS AN INSTRUMENT WE ⛔ AUTHORED — and the standing law only ever told the ⛔ CALLER to distrust the return.** ⇒ ⛔ **that asks every caller, forever, to compensate for a defect the ⛔ author could have closed ⛔ once.**

📌⛔⛔⭐⭐ **THE ⛔ EIGHTH, ⛔ ADDED 2026-09-03 (`TASK-928`) — ⛔ AND IT IS THE ⛔ FIRST WHERE THE ⛔ VERIFICATION INSTRUMENT ITSELF FAILED SILENTLY ⛔ WHILE VERIFYING THE COMMIT THAT EXISTS TO ⛔ FIX SILENT FAILURE:** the `§25b` cl. S ⛔ binary-integrity sweep reported ⛔ **`0 mismatches` from ⛔ `0 JOINED ROWS`.** ⛔ **Cause: `sha256sum` in ⛔ BINARY MODE writes `<hash> *<path>` — the ⛔ `*` broke ⛔ every join key**, so the pre/post join matched ⛔ nothing at all. ⇒ ⛔⛔ **A ⛔ TOTAL JOIN FAILURE THAT ⛔ PRINTED A PERFECT RESULT.**
- ⭐ **CAUGHT ⛔ ONLY by the positive control, and ⛔ self-reported** — ⛔ the row that found it was the row ⛔ running it.
- ✅ **THE RULE, ⛔ generalised beyond `sha256sum`: ⛔ ANY JOIN, DIFF OR SET-COMPARISON ⛔ REPORTS ITS ⛔ CARDINALITY ⛔ BESIDE ITS RESULT.** ⛔ **`mismatches: 0` is ⛔ meaningless without ⛔ `joined: N` next to it; ⛔ `missing: 0` is meaningless without ⛔ `compared: N`.** ⚖️ ***⛔ A SWEEP THAT JOINS ⛔ NOTHING REPORTS THE ⛔ SAME `0` AS ONE THAT MATCHES ⛔ EVERYTHING — ⛔ and the reassuring reading is the ⛔ default one.***
- ⛔ **IT IS THE ⛔ SAME SHAPE AS THE DEFECT `44a8710` EXISTS TO FIX** (⛔ a tool chain reporting SUCCESS over a ⛔ black frame) and as `TASK-925`'s ⛔ `IFS= read -r` bug. ⇒ ⛔ **the family is now ⛔ EIGHT, and its ⛔ centre of gravity has moved from ⛔ *"the tool lies"* to ⛔ *"the CHECK ON the tool lies, ⛔ in the ⛔ passing direction"*** (⛔ `SC-§44`'s ⛔ reassuring-direction clause, ⛔ one layer up).

✅ **THE RULE, ⛔ binding on every `Tools/**/*.py` this project writes or edits:**
1. ⛔⛔ **A TOOL THAT PRODUCES AN ARTEFACT ⛔ VALIDATES THAT ARTEFACT ⛔ BEFORE REPORTING SUCCESS.** ⛔ *"The API returned 200"* / *"the file was written"* / *"the call did not throw"* are ⛔ NOT success. ⛔ **Success is *"the thing I was asked to make ⛔ exists and ⛔ is not degenerate"*, and the ⛔ degeneracy check is ⛔ named in the exit contract.**
2. ⛔ **THE CHEAP CHECK IS ⛔ USUALLY SUFFICIENT AND THERE IS ⛔ NO EXCUSE FOR ITS ABSENCE** — ⛔ a mean/variance guard, a ⛔ size floor, a ⛔ non-empty bounds read. ⚠️ **`TASK-833` ⛔ had to write that guard ⛔ by hand, ⛔ outside the tool, ⛔ to get through the task** ⇒ ⛔ **the check was ⛔ known, ⛔ trivial and ⛔ performed — ⛔ just in the wrong place, ⛔ once, ⛔ by one agent, ⛔ unshared.**
3. ⛔⛔ **A DESTRUCTIVE `--force` MUST ⛔ NOT DESTROY THE PRIOR GOOD ARTEFACT ⛔ BEFORE THE NEW ONE VALIDATES.** ⛔ **Write-then-validate-then-swap, ⛔ never validate-nothing-and-overwrite.** ⚖️ *⛔ A tool that ⛔ fails is a delay; ⛔ a tool that fails ⛔ AND deletes the good copy ⛔ costs the run twice.*
4. ⛔ **`SC-§39`'s positive control applies to the tool's ⛔ OWN test: ⛔ prove the new guard goes ⛔ RED on a ⛔ synthesised degenerate artefact** (`SHIP-§9` — ⛔ validate a gate against the ⛔ FAILURE it detects). ⛔ **A guard only ever seen passing is ⛔ indistinguishable from no guard.**
5. ⛔ **`Tools/**/*.py` is ⛔ CODE ⇒ the ⛔ tooling QA gate applies ⛔ before commit** — ⛔ unchanged, ⛔ restated because this clause will tempt an artist to fix a tool mid-task. ⭐ **`TASK-833` was ⛔ right to report and ⛔ not fix.**
6. ⛔⛔⭐⭐ **CLAUSE 6 (added 2026-09-02) — ⛔ THE POSITIVE CONTROL COVERS ⛔ EVERY CHECK THE GUARD OWNS, ⛔ NOT MERELY THE ONES THAT ARE ⛔ CHEAP TO SYNTHESISE ⛔ IN MEMORY.** (⛔ bought by `qa/TASK-865.md` WARN-2 — ⛔ over `TASK-864`'s ⛔ OWN, ⛔ otherwise ⛔ exemplary control)
   - ⛔ **THE MEASURED EVENT.** `concept_generate.py`'s `run_guard_self_test` drives ⛔ 10 fixtures and asserts the ⛔ EXACT SET of checks that fired. ⭐ **A genuinely excellent control: ⛔ FOUR of its ⛔ FIVE checks own a fixture where they fire ⛔ ALONE, so a ⛔ DEAD CHECK ⛔ CANNOT HIDE BEHIND A LIVE ONE** (⛔ QA verified this by ⛔ hand-deriving all four isolating fixtures' statistics, ⛔ not by reading the comment that says so). ⛔ **The ⛔ FIFTH — `unreadable-artefact` — is raised ⛔ ONLY by `validate_png_file`, and ⛔ NOTHING in `--check` calls it.** ⇒ ⛔⛔ **MEASURED: ⛔ DELETE that zero-byte/decode guard and ⛔ `--check` STAYS GREEN.**
   - ⭐ **WHY IT HAPPENED, ⛔ and it is ⛔ NOT carelessness — ⛔ this is the ⛔ generalisable half: ⛔ the other four checks are ⛔ PURE FUNCTIONS OF AN ⛔ IN-MEMORY IMAGE; ⛔ the fifth needs a ⛔ FILE ON DISK.** ⇒ ⛔ **the uncontrolled check is ⛔ predictably the one whose fixture costs ⛔ four more lines (`tempfile`).** ⚖️ *⛔ THE GAP FOLLOWS THE ⛔ COST GRADIENT, ⛔ NOT THE RISK GRADIENT — ⛔ which is ⛔ exactly why it needs a ⛔ RULE rather than ⛔ diligence, ⛔ and why the author (⛔ who did everything else right) ⛔ missed it.*
   - ✅ **THE RULE: ⛔ ENUMERATE the guard's checks, and ⛔ FOR EACH ONE ⛔ NAME THE FIXTURE WHERE IT FIRES ⛔ ALONE.** ⛔ **A check with ⛔ no such fixture is ⛔ UNCONTROLLED and must be ⛔ DECLARED as such.** ⛔ **And the control belongs in the ⛔ ALWAYS-RUN TIER: a control that lives ⛔ only in a file someone has to ⛔ remember to run is a control with a ⛔ KNOWN FAILURE MODE** — ⛔ the very thing `TASK-864` ⛔ correctly rejected for the ⛔ other four.
   - ⚖️ ***⛔⛔ THE DURABLE SENTENCE: ⛔ A CONTROL THAT CANNOT PROVE ONE OF ITS ⛔ OWN CHECKS STILL WORKS IS THE ⛔ SAME SPECIES AS THE DEFECT IT GUARDS.*** ⇒ ⛔ **this law now stands at ⛔ THREE LEVELS: ⛔ (1) the TOOL lied · ⛔ (2) the GUARD could have been dead and ⛔ nobody would know · ⛔ (3) the ⛔ CONTROL can be ⛔ PARTLY DEAD ⛔ AND STILL GREEN.** ⭐ **Boarded as `TASK-879`; ⛔ written forward into `TASK-876` (⛔ item 4a) and `TASK-385`/`TASK-386` (⛔ clause d) so ⛔ NO NEW GUARD INHERITS IT.**
   - ⛔⛔⭐⭐ **THE ⛔ CRASH RIDER (added 2026-09-03; ⛔ bought by `TASK-876`, ⛔ ruled in by `qa/TASK-878.md` §5, and it ⛔ DESCRIBES SHIPPED CODE rather than ⛔ prescribing new work) — ⛔ CLAUSE 6 ASSUMED THE FAILURE MODE WAS *"THE CONTROL STAYS ⛔ GREEN"*. ⛔ THERE IS A ⛔ SECOND ONE, AND IT IS ⛔ WORSE.**
     - ⛔ **THE MEASURED EVENT.** `TASK-876` inherited a trellis guard where `CHECK_UNREADABLE` is raised from ⛔ TWO structurally distinct sites — the ⛔ bytes branch and `validate_glb_file`'s ⛔ `except OSError` — and ⛔ every pre-existing fixture ⛔ wrote a file before validating it ⇒ ⛔ the `OSError` branch was reached by ⛔ NO fixture. ⛔ **Deleting the guarded branch did ⛔ NOT leave `--check` green: it made `--check` ⛔ CRASH, with an ⛔ uncaught `FileNotFoundError` naming a temp path.**
     - ⛔⛔ **WHY A ⛔ DYING CONTROL IS ⛔ WORSE THAN A ⛔ PASSING ONE, and the reason is ⛔ operational rather than aesthetic: ⛔ THE OBVIOUS RESPONSE TO A CRASHING CONTROL IS TO ⛔ "FIX" THE CONTROL — ⛔ and the person who does that is the person ⛔ LEAST EQUIPPED TO KNOW THEY ARE ⛔ DELETING A GUARD.** ⇒ ⚖️ ***⛔ A GREEN CONTROL AT LEAST FAILS ⛔ SILENTLY; A ⛔ CRASHING ONE ⛔ ACTIVELY RECRUITS THE NEXT READER INTO ⛔ REMOVING IT.***
     - ✅ **THE RULE: ⛔ A FIXTURE SUITE ⛔ CATCHES AN UNEXPECTED EXCEPTION AND ⛔ RECORDS IT AS A ⛔ DISAGREEMENT ⛔ NAMING THE FIXTURE. ⛔ THE GUARD MUST ⛔ REJECT, ⛔ NEVER ⛔ EXPLODE — ⛔ a control that dies is a control that will be "fixed" by whoever is ⛔ unlucky enough to hit it.** ⭐ **Both siblings ⛔ already implement exactly that (`_run_fixture_suite`'s generic `except Exception` → `f"{name}: … but the guard RAISED {type(exc).__name__}"`) ⇒ ⛔ this clause is ⛔ DESCRIPTIVE, and a ⛔ new guard that ⛔ lacks it is a ⛔ QA blocker on sight.**
     - ⭐ **AND THE ⛔ FREE COROLLARY THE SAME EVENT PAID FOR: ⛔ the meta-control reports ⛔ 7 disagreements against ⛔ 8 rejecting fixtures ⛔ because `missing-file` is rejected ⛔ BEFORE `assess_degeneracy` is ever called.** ⇒ ⛔ **that ⛔ ASYMMETRY IS ⛔ ITSELF EVIDENCE the two raise sites are ⛔ genuinely distinct — ⛔ a single-site guard would have given ⛔ 8.** ⚖️ *⛔ When a meta-control's number ⛔ disagrees with your fixture count, ⛔ derive the difference ⛔ before you "correct" either — ⛔ the gap is usually ⛔ telling you something about the ⛔ call graph.*
7. ⛔⛔⭐⭐ **CLAUSE 7 (added 2026-09-03) — ⛔⛔ A COMPILE IS A ⛔ SYNTAX MEASUREMENT, ⛔ NEVER A ⛔ COMPLETENESS MEASUREMENT. ⛔ AN INTERRUPTED FILE THAT ⛔ COMPILES IS ⛔ WORSE THAN ONE THAT ⛔ DOES NOT.** (⛔ bought by the 2026-09-03 network outage that killed `TASK-876`'s first agent mid-write; ⛔ recommended by its ⛔ successor; 🧑 **and the manager's own false all-clear is in the exhibit list below, ⛔ deliberately**)
   - ⛔⛔ **THE MEASURED EVENT.** The outage left `Tools/ArtPipeline/meshy_generate.py` carrying a ⛔ module docstring that stated, ⛔ IN THE PRESENT TENSE, that ⛔ TWO guard functions ⛔ had been added — beside ⛔ **27 new constants and ⛔ NOT ONE FUNCTION.** ⛔ **`py_compile` ⛔ PASSED.** ⇒ ⛔ **because ⛔ PROSE IS NOT A SYNTAX ERROR, and a ⛔ constant that nothing reads is ⛔ not a syntax error either.**
   - ⛔⛔ **WHY IT IS ⛔ WORSE THAN UNTOUCHED, ⛔ which is the whole clause: ⛔ AN UNTOUCHED FILE IS ⛔ HONESTLY BROKEN. ⛔ THAT ONE ⛔ DOCUMENTED A GUARD IT ⛔ DID NOT HAVE** — ⛔ so the ⛔ next reader's ⛔ cheapest check (⛔ read the docstring) returns the ⛔ reassuring answer, and the ⛔ artefact itself is the ⛔ thing lying.
   - 🧑⚖️ **THE MANAGER'S OWN PART, ⛔ ON THE RECORD (`SC-§40` cl. 7's habit, ⛔ kept): ⛔ I RAN `py_compile` ON THE THREE TOUCHED FILES, ⛔ SAW THREE PASSES, AND REPORTED *"NOTHING CORRUPTED"* TO JONATHAN.** ⛔ **That was ⛔ MY ERROR.** ⛔ **I chose an instrument that ⛔ cannot answer the question I was asking** — ⛔ *"did the interrupted write finish?"* is a ⛔ COMPLETENESS question, and I answered it with a ⛔ SYNTAX tool ⛔ because the syntax tool was the one that ⛔ ran in two seconds.
   - ✅ **THE RULE: ⛔ AFTER ANY INTERRUPTION — ⛔ outage, kill, crash, resumed session — ⛔ A FILE IS PROVEN BY ⛔ SYMBOL PRESENCE PLUS A ⛔ CONTROL THAT GOES RED, ⛔ NEVER BY A COMPILE OR A LINT.** ⛔ **Name the symbols the work was supposed to add, ⛔ grep for their `def`/`UCLASS`/`IMPLEMENT_` ⛔ DEFINITION SITES (⛔ not their mentions), and ⛔ run the guard against a ⛔ known-bad input.** ⛔ **A green compile on a half-written file is a ⛔ SUCCESS RETURN — ⛔ this section's entire subject.**
   - ⛔ **AND THE COROLLARY FOR ⛔ DOCSTRINGS AND COMMENTS: ⛔ prose that describes code in the ⛔ PRESENT TENSE is an ⛔ UNCHECKED ASSERTION shipped inside the artefact it describes.** ⭐ **It is the ⛔ same species as `WITCH-§1`'s instruction-not-description clause and as `SC-§41` cl. 4 — ⛔ text inside a file is ⛔ not inert, and ⛔ two different instruments have now been fooled by it in ⛔ one evening.**

⭐⭐⭐ **THE SHARPEST SENTENCE THIS LAW HAS PRODUCED, ⛔ QUOTED BECAUSE IT IS THE ⛔ DETECTION RULE AND ⛔ NOT MERELY A STORY** (`TASK-864`, verifying the premise ⛔ before writing the fix): driving the ⛔ UNMODIFIED function with a black frame printed **`SUCCESS -> Witch.png (3,129 bytes)`**, returned ⛔ **0**, and ⛔ destroyed an **837,664-byte** good roll.

⇒ ✅ **THE OPERATIONAL RULE: ⛔ THE DATA NEEDED TO CATCH A BLIND INSTRUMENT IS ⛔ OFTEN ALREADY ON SCREEN, ⛔ UNREAD — ⛔ because it sits next to a word that ⛔ tells you not to read it.** ⛔ **When a tool reports success ⛔ WITH a measurement, ⛔ read the measurement ⛔ against an expectation, ⛔ or the measurement is ⛔ decoration.**

📌 **THE ⛔ SIX, ⛔ named together because the ⛔ family is the finding:** ⛔ the invalid binary grep · ⛔ `CountOccurrencesInCode`'s `/*` skip (⛔ measured by `TASK-867` ⛔ EATING 16 REAL HITS, and a ⛔ trailing `//` on a code line ⛔ MANUFACTURING a false one — ⛔ it is blind in ⛔ BOTH directions) · ⛔ `save_asset` returning `true` while writing nothing · ⛔ `concept_generate.py`'s black frame · ⭐ **`AssetTools.is_dirty` returning `true` for everything** · ⭐⭐ **`RM_2DOffset` reading back correctly and ⛔ refracting NOTHING (2026-09-03, `TASK-832`).**
⭐⭐ **AND THE ⛔ SHAPE OF THE SIX, ⛔ WHICH IS NOW WORTH MORE THAN THE LIST: ⛔ THREE OF THEM ARE ⛔ COUNTING/READ-BACK VERBS (⛔ grep, ⛔ `is_dirty`, ⛔ the enum read-back) AND ⛔ THREE ARE ⛔ WRITE-CONFIRMATION VERBS (⛔ `save_asset`, ⛔ the black frame, ⛔ the byte-size pass).** ⇒ ⛔ **⛔ EVERY ONE OF THEM SITS AT THE EXACT MOMENT AN AGENT ⛔ STOPS LOOKING. ⛔ That is not a coincidence about the tools; ⛔ it is a fact about ⛔ where verification ends.**

### SC-§40 ⛔⛔⛔ **AN ⛔ ABSENCE IS A ⛔ MEASUREMENT, ⛔ NOT A BELIEF — AND A ⛔ QA VERDICT OR AN ⛔ ORCHESTRATOR RELAY IS A ⛔ CITATION, ⛔ NOT A FACT** (added 2026-09-02; the ⛔ **FIFTH** law-fact drift of the day and the ⛔ **FIRST carried by a GATE'S OWN VERDICT**; bought by `HELP-§7` → `TASK-852`, ⛔ caught by `TASK-823` — ⛔ **and the manager names its own part in it**)

> ### ⚖️⭐⭐ **`SC-§38` fires when the ⛔ CODE moves under a law. ⛔ THIS ONE FIRES WHEN THE LAW WAS ⛔ NEVER TRUE — and it names the ⛔ two channels that carried it: a ⛔ QA RULING and a ⛔ MANAGER RELAY, ⛔ the two things everyone downstream treats as ⛔ settled.**

⛔ **THE MEASURED EVENT, ⛔ end to end:**
1. ⛔ `HELP-§7` shipped the sentence *"⛔ THERE IS ⛔ NO REFERENTIAL-INTEGRITY CHECK ON THIS FIELD."* ⛔ **Nobody had looked for one.** The nearest test (`RequiredIds[]`) was checked, found not to be it, and ⛔ **"the wrong test does not do it" was read as "no test does it."**
2. ⛔ `qa/TASK-822.md` ruled *"YES, board the referential-integrity test"* — ⛔ **a gate's verdict, resting on the law's premise, ⛔ which the gate did not check.**
3. ⛔ The manager relayed that ruling to the orchestrator ⛔ **as a decided thing**, and boarded `TASK-852` on it.
4. ✅ `TASK-823` opened the file and ⛔ **MEASURED the walk already shipping** — inside **test 9, `FSiegeControlsHelpAuthoredDetailTest`**, ⛔ derived over every row. ⇒ ⛔ **`TASK-852` items (1)+(2) were ⛔ GREEN THE DAY THEY WERE WRITTEN, and dispatching it would have shipped a ⛔ DUPLICATE.**

1. ✅⛔⛔ **CLAUSE 1 — THE RULE WITH TEETH: ⛔ A SPEC OR LAW SENTENCE OF THE FORM *"X DOES NOT EXIST"* / *"THERE IS NO Y"* / *"MEASURED MISSING"* IS ⛔ NOT SHIPPABLE UNTIL THE ⛔ ABSENCE IS MEASURED — ⛔ AT ⛔ BOARDING TIME, ⛔ NOT AT DISPATCH TIME — WITH THE ⛔ INSTRUMENT NAMED IN THE ROW.** ⛔ **`SC-§39`'s positive control binds here: *"I looked and found nothing"* is ⛔ not evidence; *"I looked, the ⛔ sibling cases came back, and ⛔ this one did not"* ⛔ IS.** ⭐ **Name the instrument so the implementer can ⛔ RE-RUN it in ten seconds instead of ⛔ re-deriving the belief.**
2. ⛔⛔ **CLAUSE 2 — AN ABSENCE HAS ⛔ TWO SURFACES, AND THIS ONE COST MORE THAN THE FIRST: ⛔ THE ⛔ ARTEFACT ⛔ AND ⛔ THE BOARD.** ⛔ **`CARDBAR-§9` recorded the map-marks row *"MEASURED MISSING"* ⛔ correctly of the CODE — while ⛔ `TASK-751` had been boarded for that exact row for ⛔ a day and had ⛔ never run.** ⇒ ⛔ **before writing *"missing"*, ⛔ SEARCH `TASKBOARD.md` for the feature ⛔ AND for any `backlog` row that names it.** ⚠️ **A duplicate row in a help registry is ⛔ silent, ⛔ passes every test, and is ⛔ visible only to the player.** 📌 *Second corroboration existed in the ⛔ code itself: `SiegeMapMark.h`'s header ⛔ named `TASK-751`. ⛔ The evidence was ⛔ two greps away in ⛔ two independent places.*
3. ⛔⛔⭐ **CLAUSE 3 — ⛔ A QA VERDICT AND AN ORCHESTRATOR/MANAGER RELAY ⛔ CARRY THEIR PREMISES, ⛔ AND THE PREMISES DO ⛔ NOT INHERIT THE VERDICT'S AUTHORITY.** ⛔ **A ruling is authoritative about ⛔ WHAT IT EXAMINED. ⛔ It is ⛔ NOT authoritative about a fact it ⛔ ASSUMED.** ⇒ ✅ **THE OPERATIONAL FORM, ⛔ so this is a procedure and not a sentiment:**
   - ⛔ **A QA verdict that ⛔ RECOMMENDS NEW WORK ⛔ states the premise it rests on ⛔ as a premise** (*"this is boarded on `HELP-§7`'s claim that no such test exists — ⛔ I did not verify that claim"*), ⛔ so the manager knows what is ⛔ unmeasured.
   - ⛔ **A task boarded on a ⛔ relayed fact carries that fact as ⛔ ITEM (0): ⛔ VERIFY THE PREMISE FIRST, ⛔ REPORT THE MEASUREMENT ⛔ EVEN WHEN IT CONFIRMS, ⛔ STOP IF IT REFUTES.** ⭐ *`TASK-809`'s palette gate is the ⛔ shipped precedent and it ⛔ worked: ⛔ ten seconds, ⛔ hard stop, ⛔ measured both ways.*
   - ⛔ **A relay says ⛔ WHO measured it and ⛔ WHEN, ⛔ or it says *"unverified"*. ⛔ *"QA ruled X"* is a ⛔ provenance claim, ⛔ not a measurement** (`SC-§38` cl. 6's dispatch-prompt defect, ⛔ one level up: ⛔ that clause governs ⛔ coordinates, ⛔ this one governs ⛔ facts).
4. ⛔ **CLAUSE 4 — THE DISCOVERABILITY COROLLARY: ⛔ AN ASSERTION FILED UNDER AN ⛔ UNRELATED NAME IS ⛔ OPERATIONALLY ABSENT.** ⛔ Test 9 was named for ⛔ *detail authoring* and was ⛔ also the graph's ⛔ only integrity check ⇒ ⛔ **two independent readers concluded it did not exist, ⛔ and both were reading carefully.** ⇒ ✅ **A test's ⛔ NAME is part of its ⛔ contract: when one test carries an assertion its name does ⛔ not advertise, ⛔ that assertion gets ⛔ re-implemented.**
5. ⚖️⭐ **CLAUSE 5 — THE ⛔ CHEAPEST DETECTOR, ⛔ NAMED, ⛔ because all five of the day's drifts had it available: ⛔ THE ⛔ ONE READER WHO ⛔ OPENS THE FILE ⛔ BEATS EVERY READER WHO ⛔ REASONS ABOUT IT.** ⛔ **`TASK-823` found this by ⛔ authoring rows from source instead of from handoffs (`HELP-§2` mech. 3), which is ⛔ exactly what mechanism 3 exists to force.** ⇒ ⭐ **the anti-staleness rule earned its keep on a ⛔ target it was ⛔ not aimed at.**
6. ⚖️ **SCOPE — ⛔ this does ⛔ NOT require re-measuring every fact in every law before every task; ⛔ that is `SC-§38` cl. 3's job and it is ⛔ already scoped to the ⛔ gate over the diff.** ⛔ **`SC-§40` binds ⛔ two narrow classes: ⛔ (a) claims of ⛔ ABSENCE, and ⛔ (b) facts relayed ⛔ as settled by a gate or a manager.** ⭐ **Both are cheap to check and both are ⛔ load-bearing by construction — ⛔ nobody boards a task on a fact that ⛔ does not matter.**
7. 🧑⚖️ **AND THE MANAGER'S OWN PART, ⛔ ON THE RECORD, ⛔ because a law about relayed facts written by the relayer is ⛔ worthless if it hides that: ⛔ I passed `qa/TASK-822.md`'s ruling upward as ⛔ DECIDED, ⛔ boarded `TASK-852` on it, and ⛔ did not open `SiegeControlsHelpTest.cpp`.** ⛔ **The programmer did, in the ⛔ course of a different task.** ⇒ ⭐ *⛔ The pipeline caught it — ⛔ but it caught it ⛔ downstream of two gates, and ⛔ that is the ⛔ distance this section is meant to shorten.*
8. ✅⭐⭐ **CLAUSE 3 FIRED ⛔ AGAIN WITHIN THE HOUR — ⛔ AND THE SECOND TIME THE ⛔ RELAYER CAUGHT ITSELF, WHICH IS THE ⛔ BEHAVIOUR THIS SECTION IS FOR.** ⛔ **`TASK-853`'s handoff claimed a sibling sweep would turn a ⛔ green row RED. ⛔ The orchestrator relayed it to the manager ⛔ as a measured fact. ⛔ `qa/TASK-854.md` re-derived it and it ⛔ does not reproduce** (`GetSafeNormal`'s tolerance branch — see `SC-§37.1`). ⭐ **The orchestrator then reported ⛔ against itself, ⛔ unprompted, ⛔ with the correction attached and an explicit *"do not write this into law"*.** ⇒ ⚖️ *⛔ TWO instances, ⛔ one day, ⛔ both on the ⛔ relay channel — ⛔ that is what promoted this from an observation to a section. ⭐ And the ⛔ cost of the second was ⛔ zero, ⛔ because the relay ⛔ came with its own retraction ⛔ before anything was boarded on it.*

9. ⛔⛔⭐⭐ **CLAUSE 9 — ⛔ A ⛔ COUNT IN A LAW IS A ⛔ CITATION, ⛔ NOT A MEASUREMENT. ⛔ AND THE FIX IS ⛔ STANDING DISPATCH TEXT, ⛔ NOT A MANAGER WHO REMEMBERS.** (added 2026-09-02; ⛔ the **THIRD** relay-channel drift of the day and the ⛔ **SECOND number the manager passed downward that was wrong**; bought by `WITCH-§8`'s *"three scans across two functions"*, ⛔ caught by `TASK-851`)
   - ⛔ **THE EVENT:** `WITCH-§8` shipped a ⛔ table of ⛔ 3 bot scans. ⛔ The manager relayed *"three scans"* to the programmer ⛔ as fact. ⛔ **The programmer re-measured ⛔ by symbol and found ⛔ FIVE unit-perception sites across ⛔ FOUR functions** — the missing one, `FindLightningTowerTarget`, ⛔ would have had the bot ⛔ spend 40 gold aiming at units its own ⛔ resolver cannot damage.
   - ⛔⛔ **WHY THIS IS ⛔ NOT JUST CLAUSE 3 AGAIN:** clause 3 governs a ⛔ *fact* relayed as settled. ⛔ **A COUNT IS WORSE, ⛔ because a count ⛔ LOOKS LIKE A MEASUREMENT — ⛔ it has a number in it.** ⇒ ⛔ **a downstream reader who has internalised *"re-measure relayed facts"* will ⛔ still not re-derive a ⛔ tabulated integer, ⛔ because the table ⛔ reads as the measurement it once was.** ⚖️ *⛔ `SC-§38` says a `file:line` is a ⛔ dated annotation. ⛔ **This says the SAME of a COUNT — ⛔ and a count is more dangerous, because it carries ⛔ no visible timestamp and ⛔ nothing in it goes stale-looking.***
   - ✅ **THE RULE: ⛔ any enumeration in law (*"N sites"*, *"nine call sites"*, *"the four lanes"*, *"three scans"*) is ⛔ RE-MEASURED BY SYMBOL by ⛔ every consumer, and the consumer ⛔ REPORTS THE COUNT IT FOUND ⛔ EVEN WHEN IT MATCHES.** ⛔ **A silent match is ⛔ indistinguishable from a skipped check.**
   - ✅⭐⭐ **AND THE PROCEDURAL HALF, ⛔ which is the part that actually prevents a recurrence: ⛔ *"RE-MEASURE RATHER THAN TRUSTING MY COUNT"* IS NOW ⛔ STANDING TEXT IN ⛔ EVERY DISPATCH PROMPT, ⛔ NOT A SENTENCE THE MANAGER ADDS WHEN IT OCCURS TO HIM.** ⛔ **It is what saved `TASK-851`, and it was present ⛔ by luck.** ⇒ ⛔ **the manager writes it into the row's `spec:` as ⛔ item (0) wherever a row cites a count, ⛔ exactly as clause 3 requires for a relayed fact.** ⚖️ *⛔ A safeguard that depends on someone remembering it is ⛔ a safeguard with a known failure mode, and ⛔ we have now watched it fail ⛔ twice in one evening on ⛔ the same channel.*
   - 🧑 **THE MANAGER'S OWN PART, ⛔ ON THE RECORD ⛔ AGAIN:** ⛔ **I wrote the 3-scan table, ⛔ I relayed it as fact, and ⛔ I did not open `SiegeBotController.cpp` to count.** ⛔ **The programmer did.** ⇒ ⭐ *⛔ Second time today the pipeline caught ⛔ my number rather than ⛔ my reasoning — ⛔ and both times it was caught by the ⛔ one agent who opened the file* (`SC-§40` cl. 5).

10. ⛔⛔⭐⭐ **CLAUSE 10 — ⛔ A NUMBER ⛔ INVENTED FOR A TEST MUST BE ⛔ MEASURED ABSENT, ⛔ NEVER ⛔ ASSUMED ABSENT — ⛔ AND ⛔ DERIVING IT BEATS ⛔ PICKING IT.** (added 2026-09-02; bought by `FOG-§7` prescribing *"a ⛔ SYNTHETIC radius above the ceiling (e.g. ⛔ `700`)"* when ⛔ `Lightning` ⛔ ships `AoERadius = 700`; ⛔ caught by `TASK-838`)
   - ⛔⛔ **THE EVENT: a law written ⛔ specifically to stop a test being drawn from live data ⛔ handed the implementer a ⛔ LIVE VALUE as its example of a synthetic one.** ⇒ ⛔ **an agent obeying it ⛔ to the letter would have written a test that ⛔ claimed to be synthetic while ⛔ asserting against real data — ⛔ the ⛔ exact `SC-§37` failure ⛔ that paragraph exists to prevent, ⛔ committed ⛔ BY the paragraph.**
   - ✅ **THE RULE: ⛔ before a spec, a law or a test pins a *"synthetic"*, *"impossible"*, *"out-of-range"* or *"nonexistent"* value, ⛔ GREP THE DATA FOR IT and ⛔ say so.** ⛔ **`SC-§39`'s positive control binds: *"I picked a number nothing uses"* is ⛔ not evidence; *"I searched `cards.csv`'s 31 rows and it appears ⛔ zero times"* ⛔ IS.**
   - ⭐⭐ **AND THE ⛔ BETTER FORM, ⛔ which is what `TASK-838` actually did: ⛔ DERIVE the value from the thing it must exceed (⛔ `2 ×` the ceiling), ⛔ then prove it collides with nothing.** ⛔ **A ⛔ picked constant goes stale the day the data moves and ⛔ nothing goes red; a ⛔ derived one ⛔ cannot.** ⚖️ *⛔ Same family as `SC-§37` (a test transcribed from its spec cannot fail) and `TL-§5b` (an absolute cannot survive contact) — ⛔ all three say: ⛔ pin the RELATIONSHIP, ⛔ never the NUMBER.*

11. ⛔⛔⭐⭐ **CLAUSE 11 — ⛔ A `blocked-by` LIST IS A ⛔ PLAN, ⛔ NEVER A ⛔ MEASUREMENT. ⛔ BEFORE DISPATCHING A GATE OVER N SUBJECTS, ⛔ CHECK THAT N HANDOFFS ⛔ EXIST ON DISK.** (added 2026-09-03; ⛔ bought by `TASK-878`, ⛔ caught by the ⛔ gate itself; 🧑 **the manager's own part is named below, ⛔ third time in this section**)
   - ⛔⛔ **THE MEASURED EVENT.** `TASK-878` was boarded and dispatched as ⛔ *"ONE gate over `TASK-874` + `TASK-876`"*. ⛔ **`TASK-876` was delivered. ⛔ `TASK-874` was ⛔ NEVER DELIVERED — ⛔ still `boarded`, ⛔ no `handoffs/TASK-874-programmer.md`, ⛔ no diff to the named file.** ⇒ ⛔ **the gate's ⛔ item (a) had ⛔ NOTHING TO RULE ON, and the gate spent a sitting discovering that.** ✅ **It did the ⛔ right thing: ⛔ ruled on the half it could, ⛔ named the hole in its `SC-§29` coverage ledger, and ⛔ DECLINED to let a ⛔ half-covered gate read as a ⛔ full one.**
   - ⛔⛔ **WHY THIS IS ⛔ THE SAME SECTION AND ⛔ NOT A NEW ONE: ⛔ *"an absence is a measurement"* had only ever been applied to ⛔ CODE and to ⛔ LAW. ⛔ THIS APPLIES IT TO THE ⛔ BOARD.** ⛔ **A row's `status:` and a downstream row's `blocked-by:` are ⛔ PROSE WRITTEN BY THE MANAGER — ⛔ they are ⛔ assertions about the world, ⛔ not observations of it, and ⛔ nothing goes red when one drifts.** ⇒ ⚖️ ***⛔ THE BOARD IS AN ⛔ ARTEFACT LIKE ANY OTHER, AND IT IS ⛔ SUBJECT TO ITS OWN LAWS.***
   - ✅ **THE RULE, ⛔ and it is ⛔ ten seconds: ⛔ a gate over N named subjects is ⛔ NOT DISPATCHED until ⛔ N deliverables ⛔ EXIST — ⛔ glob `handoffs/TASK-###-*.md` for ⛔ EACH ONE.** ⛔ **The gate row's `blocked-by:` says ⛔ *"THE DELIVERABLE, ⛔ NOT THE ROW"*, and the ⛔ gate is entitled to ⛔ refuse to start ⛔ rather than open with an empty ledger.** ⭐ **And if a subject is missing at dispatch time, ⛔ SPLIT THE ROW — ⛔ never ⛔ hold a delivered task hostage to an undelivered sibling.** ⛔ **`TASK-878` was ⛔ split into `TASK-889` for exactly that reason, and ⛔ `TASK-876` shipped on schedule.**
   - ⛔⛔⛔⭐⭐ **IT ⛔ RECURRED ⛔ THE SAME NIGHT — ⛔ WITHIN ⛔ HOURS OF THIS CLAUSE BEING WRITTEN, AND ⛔ THAT IS RECORDED HERE RATHER THAN QUIETLY RE-FIXED.** ⛔ **`TASK-872` was dispatched as *"ONE gate over `TASK-870` + `TASK-871`"*. ⛔ `TASK-870` delivered. ⛔ `TASK-871` — ⛔ NO DIFF, ⛔ NO HANDOFF.** ⇒ ⛔ **the ⛔ SECOND undelivered subject in ⛔ ONE NIGHT, on a board that had ⛔ just made this a law.**
   - ⚖️⭐⭐ **THE ⛔ HONEST READING, ⛔ BOTH HALVES, ⛔ BECAUSE ONLY ONE OF THEM IS COMFORTABLE: ⛔ (i) THE LAW ⛔ FIRED ⛔ AS DESIGNED — ⛔ the gate ⛔ reported an ⛔ EMPTY HALF and ⛔ refused to let a half-covered gate read as a full one, so the work did ⛔ NOT vanish silently, which is ⛔ exactly the outcome this clause was written to buy. ⛔ (ii) IT ⛔ DID NOT ⛔ PREVENT THE RECURRENCE.** ⇒ ⛔⛔ **A LAW THAT ⛔ DETECTS RELIABLY AND ⛔ PREVENTS NOT AT ALL IS ⛔ HALF A LAW — ⛔ and ⛔ noticing that is ⛔ the whole value of writing the second occurrence down beside the first.**
   - ⛔⛔ **THE ⛔ DIAGNOSIS, ⛔ AND IT IS ⛔ STRUCTURAL RATHER THAN A DISCIPLINE FAILURE: ⛔ THIS CLAUSE FIRES AT ⛔ GATE-DISPATCH TIME, WHICH IS ⛔ ALREADY ⛔ ONE TASK ⛔ TOO LATE.** ⛔ **By then a programmer task has been ⛔ marked dispatched, a gate has been ⛔ boarded behind it, and a ⛔ RIDER'S PATHSPEC has been ⛔ WRITTEN FROM THE PLAN** — ⛔ **which is how `TASK-873` came to name ⛔ FOUR files when its subject touched ⛔ THREE, ⛔ the other two belonging to the ⛔ task that never ran** (⛔ caught by `qa/TASK-872.md` W-6, ⛔ the ⛔ FIRST pathspec trap caught ⛔ BEFORE its task was dispatched).
   - ~~⚖️ **OPEN QUESTION, ⛔ BOARDED (`TASK-914` item 4) RATHER THAN LEFT IN A MESSAGE: ⛔ SHOULD THE `§25b` cl. R RECONCILIATION RUN AT ⛔ DISPATCH TIME, ⛔ NOT ONLY AT ⛔ COMMIT TIME?**~~ ⇒ ⚖️⚖️⭐⭐ **RULED 2026-09-03 BY THE MANAGER, ⛔ SAME SITTING, ⛔ NOT DEFERRED: ⛔ YES. ⛔ THE RECONCILIATION RUNS AT ⛔ DISPATCH TIME, AND IT IS THE ⛔ MANAGER'S — ⛔ NOT THE GATE'S AND ⛔ NOT THE REVIEWER'S.**
     - ⛔ **WHY IT IS RULED RATHER THAN ASKED: ⛔ TWO OCCURRENCES IN ⛔ ONE NIGHT IS A ⛔ PATTERN, ⛔ NOT AN ACCIDENT** (`TASK-874` under `TASK-878`; `TASK-871` under `TASK-872`) — ⛔ **and the ⛔ deciding fact is ⛔ already in hand: ⛔ the detector ⛔ FIRED BOTH TIMES AND ⛔ PREVENTED NEITHER.** ⇒ ⛔ **there is ⛔ nothing left to learn from a third data point, and ⛔ collecting one costs a ⛔ gate sitting.** ⚖️ *⛔ Asking an ⛔ open question of a ⛔ downstream agent is the ⛔ right move when the ⛔ evidence is thin; ⛔ here it would have been the ⛔ manager outsourcing a ⛔ manager's decision about ⛔ the manager's own bookkeeping.*
     - ✅⛔ **THE OPERATIONAL FORM, ⛔ ten seconds, ⛔ and it is a ⛔ WRITTEN ARTEFACT rather than a habit: ⛔ BEFORE dispatching a gate over ⛔ N named subjects, the manager ⛔ globs `handoffs/TASK-###-*.md` for ⛔ EACH subject and ⛔ writes the result ⛔ INTO THE GATE ROW'S `blocked-by:` ⛔ as a ⛔ DATED MEASUREMENT** — ⛔ e.g. *"`870` ✅ on disk 2026-09-03 · `871` ⛔ ABSENT"*. ⇒ ⛔⛔ **A GATE ROW WHOSE `blocked-by:` CARRIES ⛔ NO SUCH LINE IS ⛔ NOT DISPATCHABLE.** ⭐ **`TASK-914`'s `blocked-by:` is the ⛔ shipped pattern to copy.**

R's ⛔ boarding-time bullet, ⛔ added the same day).

R catches a ⛔ FILE NOBODY CLAIMED, ⛔ one step before `HEAD`. ⛔ THIS catches a ⛔ TASK NOBODY RAN, ⛔ one step before a ⛔ GATE.** ⛔ **Same reconciliation, ⛔ two stages earlier — ⛔ and it is the ⛔ only stage at which the answer is still ⛔ FREE.** ⚖️ *⛔ cl. 11(a) told the ⛔ GATE it may ⛔ refuse to start. ⛔ This tells the ⛔ MANAGER ⛔ not to make it — ⛔ the duty moved to the ⛔ one party who can act on it ⛔ before the cost is paid.*
