       > ⛔⛔ **THE RULING'S ⛔ PREDICATE IS ⛔ EXISTENCE; ITS ⛔ SUBJECT IS ⛔ DELIVERY. ⛔ THOSE ARE DIFFERENT PROPOSITIONS, AND THE GAP BETWEEN THEM IS WHERE ⛔ EVERY ONE OF TONIGHT'S FAILURES LIVES.**
       - ⛔ **(1) A handoff can ⛔ EXIST and describe a ⛔ REFUSAL, a partial, or a blocker** (⛔ `TASK-874`'s correctly *reported rather than reached*) ⇒ ⛔ the glob reads ⛔ PRESENT for a file whose whole content is *"⛔ I could not do this."*
       - ⛔ **(2) A handoff can be ⛔ STALE** ⇒ ⛔⛔ **`TL-§5d`'s ⛔ tree-vs-`HEAD` problem wearing a ⛔ DISPATCH-TIME COSTUME.** ⭐ **The mirror bit that very gate the same night: `qa/TASK-872.md`'s `427` was ⛔ CORRECT WHEN WRITTEN and ⛔ WRONG WHEN READ.**
       - ⛔⛔ **(3) IT MEASURES THE ⛔ WRONG ARTEFACT CLASS. ⛔ The DIFF is the deliverable; the ⛔ HANDOFF IS ITS RECEIPT — ⛔ and BOTH are written by the SAME agent.** ⇒ ⛔ **an agent that writes the note but ⛔ never saves the source edit produces a ⛔ PASSING PREDICATE AND A ⛔ MISSING GOOD.** ⛔ **NO receipt-based check can ⛔ ever detect an absent good.**
       - ⛔ **(4) The glob is ⛔ PER-TASK; delivery is ⛔ PER-`names:`-ENTRY** ⇒ ⛔ a handoff covering ⛔ only the tests and not the code reads ⛔ PRESENT while the reviewer still arrives at ⛔ half an empty subject.
     - ✅⭐⭐ **ADOPTED — ⛔ THE STRENGTHENING, ⛔ AND IT COSTS THE MANAGER ⛔ NOTHING EXTRA** (⛔ it is the ⛔ same shell call `§25b` cl. R ⛔ already mandates): ⛔ **PAIR THE HANDOFF GLOB WITH `git status --porcelain` AND REQUIRE ⛔ AT LEAST ONE FILE FROM THE GATE ROW'S OWN `names:` LIST TO APPEAR ⛔ DIRTY** (⛔ or newer than the row's base commit). ⇒ ⛔ **that converts an ⛔ EXISTENCE predicate into a ⛔ DELIVERY predicate and ⛔ closes (1), (2) and (4) ⛔ in one line.**
     - ⛔⛔ **AND THE ⛔ RESIDUAL IS ⛔ RECORDED HONESTLY RATHER THAN THE QUESTION BEING ⛔ CLOSED: ⛔ NOTHING CLOSES (3). ⛔ NO DISPATCH-TIME PREDICATE CAN DETECT A HANDOFF THAT IS ⛔ PRESENT, ⛔ RECENT, AND ⛔ DESCRIBES WORK THAT WAS ⛔ NEVER WRITTEN.** ⛔ **Only a ⛔ REVIEWER READING THE SOURCE can** — ⛔ which is ⛔ what happened that night in ⛔ BOTH directions: ⛔ one gate found an ⛔ EMPTY SUBJECT, and ⛔ this gate found a ⛔ NaN defect ⛔ no specification mentioned. ⇒ ⛔ **the check is ⛔ NECESSARY, ⛔ NOT SUFFICIENT, and ⛔ the row must ⛔ NEVER be allowed to ⛔ READ as sufficient.**
     - ⚖️⭐⭐ ***⛔ RECORDED AS THE ⛔ PRECEDENT FOR HOW A ⛔ MANAGER RULING GETS TESTED, ⛔ because the mechanism is reusable and ⛔ the result was better than the alternative: ⛔ I RULED IT MYSELF rather than asking (⛔ the evidence was in hand), ⛔ THEN NAMED MY OWN WEAKEST PREDICATE, ⛔ THEN INSTRUCTED THE REVIEWER TO ⛔ ATTACK IT RATHER THAN RECOMMEND. ⛔ A RECOMMENDATION WOULD HAVE PRODUCED A ⛔ SECOND SOURCE OF TRUTH; ⛔ THE ATTACK PRODUCED A ⛔ STRENGTHENING I ADOPTED AND A ⛔ RESIDUAL I WROTE DOWN.*** ⛔ **Naming your own weak point is what makes the attack ⛔ cheap enough to actually happen — ⛔ a reviewer handed *"find anything wrong"* returns ⛔ agreement.**
   - 🧑 **THE MANAGER'S OWN PART, ⛔ ON THE RECORD: ⛔ I wrote the two-subject `blocked-by`, ⛔ I dispatched the gate, and ⛔ I never checked whether `TASK-874` had produced a file.** ⛔ **A boarded task went ⛔ undelivered for a day and ⛔ NOBODY NOTICED — ⛔ not the orchestrator, ⛔ not me — ⛔ because ⛔ nothing in the pipeline ⛔ measures the gap between ⛔ "boarded" and ⛔ "started".** ⇒ ⭐ *⛔ Third time in this section that the ⛔ pipeline caught the ⛔ manager's bookkeeping rather than anyone's ⛔ reasoning — ⛔ and the ⛔ cheapest detector was, ⛔ again, ⛔ available the whole time to the ⛔ one party who never looked.*
11. ⛔⛔⭐⭐ **CLAUSE 11 — ⛔ AN *"X DOES NOT EXIST"* CLAIM MUST ⛔ NAME THE SYMBOL IT SEARCHED FOR, SO THE NEXT READER CAN ⛔ REFUTE IT IN SECONDS INSTEAD OF ⛔ RE-DERIVING IT.** (added 2026-09-02; bought by `HELP-§7` → `TASK-852`; the ⛔ THIRD data point supplied by `qa/TASK-816.md`)
   - ⛔ **THE MEASURED EVENT, ⛔ three readers, ⛔ one file:** ⛔ two independent readers concluded the `RelatedActionIds` walk did ⛔ not exist. ⛔ **A third found it in ⛔ TEN SECONDS — ⛔ and said why: *"I found it in ten seconds ⛔ because I was ⛔ HANDED THE SYMBOL."*** ⇒ ⛔ **the difference between the two outcomes was ⛔ not care, ⛔ not skill and ⛔ not time. ⛔ It was ⛔ whether the claim named what to look for.**
   - ✅ **THE RULE: ⛔ any assertion of absence — in a ⛔ LAW, a ⛔ SPEC, a ⛔ QA VERDICT or a ⛔ HANDOFF — carries ⛔ (a) the ⛔ SYMBOL or pattern searched for, ⛔ (b) the ⛔ SCOPE searched, and ⛔ (c) its ⛔ POSITIVE CONTROL.** ⛔ **Without (a) the claim is ⛔ unfalsifiable in practice: ⛔ refuting it costs a ⛔ full re-derivation, so ⛔ nobody does, so it ⛔ survives.**
   - ⭐⭐ **THIS IS `SC-§40` FROM THE ⛔ OTHER SIDE. ⛔ Clause 1 makes an absence ⛔ EXPENSIVE TO ASSERT. ⛔ Clause 11 makes it ⛔ CHEAP TO DISPROVE** — ⛔ and the second is what actually saves the project, because a wrong absence claim will ⛔ always get written eventually and the ⛔ only question is ⛔ how long it survives.
   - ⚖️ ⛔ **AND ITS COROLLARY IS ⛔ CLAUSE 4, RESTATED WITH TEETH: ⛔ if the thing being sought lives under a ⛔ NAME THAT DOES NOT ADVERTISE IT, ⛔ naming the symbol is the ⛔ ONLY thing that finds it.** ⛔ Test 9 was named for ⛔ detail authoring and ⛔ was the graph's ⛔ only integrity check.
12. ⛔⛔⭐ **CLAUSE 12 — ⛔ REBUILD THE INSTRUMENT, ⛔ DO NOT APPROXIMATE IT, AND ⛔ PROVE IT IN ⛔ BOTH DIRECTIONS.** (added 2026-09-02; bought and ⛔ demonstrated by `TASK-867`)
   - ⛔ **When you must re-derive a number a ⛔ SHIPPED TEST pins, ⛔ do ⛔ NOT reach for `grep` and ⛔ hope it agrees. ⛔ REBUILD THE TEST'S ⛔ OWN SKIP RULE** — ⭐ **`TASK-867` reproduced `CountOccurrencesInCode` exactly, ⛔ reproduced `TASK-851`'s ⛔ 4-vs-3 over-count ⛔ on demand, ⛔ found three more shipped assertions resting on it, and ⛔ showed the `/*` skip ⛔ EATING 16 REAL HITS.**
   - ⛔ **A ⛔ leading `/*` ⛔ HIDES a real hit; a ⛔ TRAILING `//` on a code line ⛔ MANUFACTURES a false one.** ⇒ ⛔ **the instrument is blind in ⛔ BOTH directions, so ⛔ ONE positive control is ⛔ not enough: ⛔ carry one per direction and ⛔ say which direction each exercised.**
   - ⭐ **Pin needles to a ⛔ CALL SHAPE (`Symbol(`), ⛔ never a bare token.**
   - ⚖️ *⛔ This was done by the ⛔ first reader who was ⛔ NOT told the answer in advance — ⛔ and it found a blind spot ⛔ 16 hits wide, ⛔ four times larger than the one that bought `SC-§39`.*

⚠️📌 **NUMBERING NOTE (manager, 2026-09-03) — ⛔ THIS SECTION HAS TWO CLAUSES NUMBERED 11 AND A CITATION OF *"`SC-§40` cl. 11"* IS THEREFORE AMBIGUOUS.** ⛔ **`11 (a)` = the `blocked-by`-is-a-plan clause** (a gate over N subjects checks N handoffs exist). ⛔ **`11 (b)` = the name-the-symbol clause** (an absence claim carries the symbol, scope and positive control). ⛔ **Cite them as `cl. 11(a)` / `cl. 11(b)`; ⛔ do NOT renumber — existing rows and handoffs already point at both.** ⚖️ *⛔ Recorded rather than fixed, because a silent renumber would break live citations — the exact hazard `SC-§38` is about.*

13. ⛔⛔⭐⭐ **CLAUSE 13 — ⛔ CLAUSE 10 IN THE ⛔ ART LANE: ⛔ A THRESHOLD INVENTED FOR A GATE MUST BE ⛔ MEASURED AGAINST THE ⛔ SHIPPED CORPUS BEFORE IT IS ⛔ TRUSTED. ⛔ A BAR 42% OF SHIPPED WORK FAILS IS A ⛔ WRONG BAR, ⛔ NOT A WRONG CORPUS.** (added 2026-09-03; bought by `TASK-834`'s outage-killed predecessor, ⛔ caught by its successor)
   - ⛔ **THE EVENT, ⛔ and it is cl. 10's shape with a ⛔ different victim: cl. 10's invented number was a *"synthetic"* value that ⛔ collided with live data. ⛔ THIS one is an ⛔ ACCEPTANCE THRESHOLD that ⛔ contradicted the population it was judging.** ⛔ Two bars — `clip < 0.5%` and figure median `[0.075, 0.150]` — were ⛔ picked, ⛔ not derived. ⛔ **13 of 31 shipped cards FAIL the first; the second sits BELOW the roster median and BELOW both M7 references.** ⇒ ⛔ **the solver spent an entire session driving a lighting knob toward a target that was WRONG, and every step it took was, by its own metric, PROGRESS.**
   - ⛔⛔ **WHY IT IS WORSE THAN cl. 10: ⛔ A COLLIDING SYNTHETIC VALUE MAKES A TEST GO ⛔ GREEN THAT SHOULD BE RED. ⛔ AN INVENTED ACCEPTANCE BAR MAKES THE ⛔ WORK ITSELF GO WRONG ⛔ WHILE REPORTING SUCCESS** — the chased face measured median **0.204** / clip **2.34%**, ⛔ **both in family**, and was ⛔ **white speckled mush.** ⇒ ⚖️ ***⛔ A metric satisfiable by an artefact nobody would ship converts "looks wrong" into "passes", and there is then ⛔ NO instrument left in the loop.***
   - ✅ **THE RULE: ⛔ before any invented threshold is used as a gate, ⛔ RUN IT OVER THE SHIPPED CORPUS AND ⛔ REPORT THE PASS RATE.** ⛔ **A corpus-wide failure rate is the ⛔ positive control for a threshold** (`SC-§39`), and it is ⛔ cheap: 31 files, one loop. ⭐ **Then express the bar as a ⛔ PERCENTILE, ⛔ never an absolute — the shipped key-colour bar (`"Card artwork (hand UI)"`) is the ⛔ pattern to copy, and it was written for ⛔ exactly this reason in ⛔ 2026-08.**
   - ⭐⭐ **AND THE ⛔ ESCAPE HATCH IS WORTH MORE THAN THE RULE, SO IT IS WRITTEN ⛔ BESIDE IT: ⛔ ALL THREE TIMES, THE THING THAT CAUGHT IT WAS A ⛔ HUMAN RENDERING THE ARTEFACT AND ⛔ LOOKING AT IT** — the clip map (mush), the frame (a floor blown to pure white over **18.6%** of it), and the key swatch (a ⛔ greenscreen, backdrop chroma **54.6** vs roster max **52.2**). ⛔ **None of the three was visible in any number the agent was tracking.** ⇒ ⛔ **for any artefact a human will ultimately look at, ⛔ VIEWING IT IS A REQUIRED STEP OF ACCEPTANCE, ⛔ not a courtesy** (`HELP-§3`'s *"a property readback is not acceptance"*, generalised; and `SC-§39.1`'s *"validate the artefact, never the exit code"*, ⛔ one layer up — ⛔ here the artefact was validated, ⛔ against the wrong bar).
   - 🧑 **THE MANAGER'S OWN PART, ⛔ ON THE RECORD — ⛔ FOURTH TIME IN THIS SECTION, AND ⛔ THIS ONE I RELAYED TO JONATHAN.** ⛔ I carried *"she bakes **3.8×** darker (0.0250 vs 0.0968)"* upward as a ⛔ fleet-consistency concern. ⛔ **It is an ⛔ ARTEFACT OF UV-ATLAS-PADDING DILUTION: both figures are ⛔ WHOLE-TEXTURE means over atlases of ⛔ 26.2% and ⛔ 66.0% coverage. ⛔ Model-only it is `0.0955` vs `0.1436` = ⛔ 1.5×.** ⇒ ⛔ **I inflated a number to Jonathan by ⛔ 2.5×.**
     - ⛔⛔⭐ **AND THE PART THAT MAKES IT A LAW RATHER THAN AN APOLOGY: ⛔ THIS PROJECT ⛔ ALREADY OWNS THE CORRECT INSTRUMENT AND ⛔ ALREADY CALLS IT BY NAME.** ⛔ **The albedo gate's *"UV-norm"* column IS raw ÷ atlas coverage** — `TASK-370` measured Sorcerer raw `0.3139` → UV-norm `0.4377` (coverage 0.717), and `TASK-834` independently measured her coverage at `0.723`. ⇒ ⛔ **a `mean_linear_after` compared ACROSS assets without UV-normalisation is comparing ⛔ ATLAS EMPTINESS, and the fleet's own pipeline has said so since 2026-08-01.** ✅ **LAW: ⛔ any cross-asset albedo/ORM comparison is stated ⛔ UV-NORMALISED (or MODEL-MASKED), and the ⛔ coverage fraction is reported beside it. ⛔ A bare whole-texture mean is a ⛔ SINGLE-ASSET diagnostic only.**

14. ⛔⛔⭐⭐ **CLAUSE 14 — ⛔ A RELAY THAT NAMES ⛔ TWO SOURCES WHEN ⛔ ONLY ONE HOLDS THE CONTENT ⛔ SENDS THE READER HUNTING — AND ⛔ THE HUNT LOOKS EXACTLY LIKE THE READER HAVING ⛔ MISSED SOMETHING.** (added 2026-09-03; 🧑 **the orchestrator's own, ⛔ reported ⛔ against itself and ⛔ unprompted — the ⛔ THIRD citation failure of the night and the ⛔ SECOND on the ⛔ relay channel**)
   - ⛔ **THE MEASURED EVENT.** A relay stated that a reviewer's ⛔ verbatim board-flip lines were *"⛔ in its report ⛔ and in its message."* ⛔ **They were in the ⛔ MESSAGE ONLY. ⛔ The report on disk carried ⛔ NO flip block at all.** ⇒ ⛔ **the manager read the ⛔ entire report hunting a block that was ⛔ never there.**
   - ✅⭐ **THE RECOVERY IS THE ⛔ SHIPPED PRECEDENT AND IT IS ⛔ WHY THIS COST NOTHING: the reader ⛔ SAID SO PLAINLY (*"I read the whole report; ⛔ there is no flip block"*), ⛔ did ⛔ NOT pretend to have found it, and ⛔ COMPOSED BOTH FLIPS FROM THE REPORT'S ⛔ OWN MEASUREMENTS.** ⇒ ⛔ **that is the ⛔ correct behaviour on a ⛔ broken citation: ⛔ report the gap, ⛔ then rebuild from ⛔ primary evidence.**
   - ⛔⛔ **WHY THIS IS ⛔ NOT PEDANTRY: AN ⛔ OVER-BROAD PROVENANCE CLAIM IS ⛔ INDISTINGUISHABLE FROM THE ⛔ READER'S OWN FAILURE.** ⛔ **A reader told *"it is in the report"* who ⛔ cannot find it must choose between *"⛔ I missed it"* and *"⛔ the relay was wrong"* — and the ⛔ cheap, ⛔ deferential, ⛔ WRONG default is the ⛔ first.** ⇒ ⛔ **the reader ⛔ re-reads, ⛔ doubts itself, ⛔ burns a sitting, and in the ⛔ worst case ⛔ INVENTS the missing content rather than ⛔ contradicting the relay.** ⚠️ **`SC-§40` cl. 3 governs a ⛔ FACT relayed as settled, ⛔ cl. 9 a ⛔ COUNT — ⛔ THIS governs a ⛔ LOCATION, and a location is the ⛔ one of the three the reader ⛔ cannot check without ⛔ already having done the work.**
   - ✅ **THE RULE: ⛔ A RELAY NAMES THE ⛔ ONE ARTEFACT THAT ⛔ HOLDS THE CONTENT, ⛔ WITH ITS PATH.** ⛔ **When content exists ⛔ ONLY in a transient message, the relay says so ⛔ EXPLICITLY — *"⛔ in my message, ⛔ NOT on disk"*.** ⛔ ***"In X ⛔ and in Y" is a ⛔ CONJUNCTION, and a conjunction ⛔ ASSERTS BOTH*** (⭐ `SC-§46`'s compound-claim rule, ⛔ turned on a ⛔ citation instead of on a ⛔ sentence about the game — ⛔ same failure, ⛔ and a reader who checks the ⛔ true half ⛔ stops there).
   - ⭐⭐ **AND THE ⛔ DOWNSTREAM HALF, ⛔ which is the expensive one: ⛔ A TRANSIENT-ONLY ARTEFACT ⛔ CANNOT BE CITED LATER.** ⛔ **The next reader of `qa/TASK-872.md` will ⛔ never see those flip lines — they exist ⛔ nowhere in the pipeline's ⛔ permanent record.** ⇒ ⛔ **if a message carries content the pipeline will ⛔ need again, it ⛔ BELONGS IN A FILE** (⛔ `CLAUDE.md`: ⛔ the files are the contract, ⛔ Slack and messages are ⛔ visibility) — ⛔ **and the ⛔ relay is the ⛔ one party positioned to notice that they are ⛔ not.**
   - 🧑 **NAMED, ⛔ not buried: the error was the ⛔ ORCHESTRATOR'S and it ⛔ corrected itself to the manager ⛔ before anything was boarded on it** — ⛔ the ⛔ same self-reporting shape as ⛔ cl. 8. ⇒ ⚖️ *⛔ FOUR of this section's fourteen clauses now record a ⛔ RELAY or ⛔ MANAGER citation defect rather than a ⛔ specialist's reasoning defect. ⛔ That is ⛔ not bad luck — it is ⛔ where this pipeline's ⛔ load actually sits, and ⛔ the reason the ⛔ files-are-the-contract rule is ⛔ load-bearing rather than ceremonial.*

15. ⛔⛔⛔⭐⭐ **CLAUSE 15 — ⛔ A QA `WARN` IS A ⛔ CITATION TOO, AND ⛔ THE FIRST PARTY WITH THE INSTRUMENT MUST RE-MEASURE ⛔ EVEN A RETRACTION. ⛔ WITHDRAWING A CLAIM ⛔ FEELS LIKE THE CAUTIOUS OPTION — ⛔ HERE IT WAS THE ⛔ WRONG ONE, AND THE ⛔ FENCED AUTHOR HAD ⛔ NO WAY TO DEFEND A ⛔ TRUE STATEMENT.** (added 2026-09-03; bought by `qa/TASK-889.md` WARN-2, ⛔ caught by `TASK-919` ⛔ ONE COMMIT LATE. ⛔ **Every other clause in this section polices an ⛔ ASSERTION. ⛔ THIS IS THE FIRST WHERE THE ⛔ WITHDRAWAL OF ONE WAS THE DEFECT.**)
   - ⛔⛔ **THE MEASURED EVENT, ⛔ IN ORDER, ⛔ BECAUSE THE ORDER IS THE WHOLE MECHANISM:**
     1. ✅ `handoffs/TASK-814-buildmaster.md:68` — the ⛔ **LAST AGENT IN THE CHAIN WITH GIT** — recorded `Tests/SiegeAssistantSelectionTest.cpp` at `38 → 39 | +1`. ⛔ **It was RIGHT.**
     2. ⛔ A ⛔ **conflation** with `Tests/SiegeFogClampTest.cpp` — ⛔ genuinely new, genuinely untracked, `+8` — put *"untracked"* into `TL-§5d` and into `TASKBOARD.md:14412`.
     3. ⛔ `qa/TASK-889.md` **WARN-2** cited ⛔ **those two records** and told the programmer his `git show HEAD:` provenance ⛔ *"cannot be true."*
     4. ⛔⛔ **He is ⛔ FENCED FROM GIT. ⛔ He could not re-derive it. ⛔ SO HE RETRACTED A CLAIM THAT WAS TRUE** — and, ⛔ correctly by every law then in force, ⛔ wrote *"do not re-relay my `+1`."*
     5. ⛔ The manager relayed `+39-never-+1` into ⛔ **FOUR dispatches as fact.** ⛔ `TASK-919` ran `git ls-files --error-unmatch`, got ⛔ **exit 0**, and the file was in ⛔ `HEAD` since `4a03e03` all along.
   - ✅⛔ **THE RULE, ⛔ AND IT IS ⛔ ONE LINE: ⛔ A RETRACTION IS A ⛔ CLAIM. ⛔ THE FIRST PARTY DOWNSTREAM WITH THE ⛔ INSTRUMENT RE-MEASURES IT ⛔ BEFORE ACTING ON IT — ⛔ exactly as `cl. 3` requires of a relayed fact and `cl. 9` of a relayed count.** ⛔ **A withdrawn figure gets the ⛔ SAME ten seconds as an asserted one, ⛔ and the result is ⛔ REPORTED EVEN WHEN IT CONFIRMS.**
   - ⛔⛔ **WHY IT IS ⛔ NOT SIMPLY `cl. 3` AGAIN, ⛔ and this is the part worth keeping: ⛔ A RETRACTION IS ⛔ EPISTEMICALLY CAMOUFLAGED. ⛔ An assertion invites challenge; ⛔ a withdrawal reads as ⛔ humility, ⛔ rigour, and ⛔ deference to a gate** ⇒ ⛔ **nobody audits it, ⛔ the author is praised for it (⛔ `qa/TASK-889.md` §5 ⛔ explicitly commended the retraction as *"the correct call"*), and the ⛔ FALSE figure inherits the ⛔ MORAL AUTHORITY of the ⛔ TRUE one it replaced.** ⚖️ ***⛔ THE CAUTIOUS-LOOKING MOVE IS ⛔ NOT AUTOMATICALLY THE ⛔ CONSERVATIVE ONE.***
   - ⛔⛔⭐ **THE STRUCTURAL HALF, ⛔ MANAGER-OWNED, ⛔ because it is the ⛔ only part that prevents rather than detects: ⛔ WHEN A GATE CONTRADICTS AN AUTHOR ON A FACT THE AUTHOR IS ⛔ FENCED FROM MEASURING, ⛔ NEITHER PARTY CAN SETTLE IT — ⛔ and *"retract"* is ⛔ the only move the fence leaves open.** ⇒ ⛔ **the correct output is ⛔ NOT a retraction but an ⛔ OPEN QUESTION ⛔ TRANSFERRED BY NAME to the first row that ⛔ HOLDS THE INSTRUMENT** (`TL-§5c` cl. 5's duty-transfer form). ⭐ **`qa/TASK-889.md` §7′(a) ⛔ DID transfer it correctly — ⛔ and then ⛔ ALSO pre-decided the answer (*"⛔ IT IS EXPECTED UNTRACKED"*), ⛔ which is what the four dispatches copied.** ⇒ ⛔ **A TRANSFERRED QUESTION IS ⛔ WRITTEN AS A QUESTION. ⛔ A transfer that ⛔ ships its own expected answer is a ⛔ relay, ⛔ not a transfer.**
   - ⛔ **AND THE ⛔ COUNTER-BIAS, ⛔ stated so this clause is not misread as *"never retract"*: ⛔ retracting an ⛔ UNSUPPORTABLE claim remains ⛔ CORRECT and remains ⛔ commendable — the ⛔ same handoff's ⛔ CRLF self-catch (`SC-§47`'s exhibit) is ⛔ the same author doing ⛔ exactly the right thing ⛔ in the same section.** ⛔ **What is forbidden is the ⛔ RETRACTION TRAVELLING DOWNSTREAM AS A ⛔ MEASURED FACT.** ⭐ **Both halves are ⛔ satisfied at once by: ⛔ *"⛔ I cannot support this; ⛔ I am not asserting the opposite either; ⛔ `TASK-###` holds the instrument and ⛔ owes the measurement."***
   - ⭐⭐ **WHY IT WENT UNNOTICED, ⛔ AND IT IS THE REASON THIS IS A CLAUSE AND NOT A FOOTNOTE: ⛔ NOTHING WAS LOST. ⛔ The file was committed either way and the ⛔ OUTCOME IS IDENTICAL** — ⛔ **`+1` and `+39` differ only in a ⛔ NUMBER IN A RECORD.** ⇒ ⛔ **a defect with ⛔ no failing consequence has ⛔ no natural discovery event; it is found ⛔ only by somebody re-measuring for ⛔ its own sake.** ⚖️ *⛔ `SC-§47`'s caveat, ⛔ confirmed from the other side: ⛔ the ⛔ harmless specimen is the one that ⛔ survives every reading.*
   - 🧑 **THE MANAGER'S OWN PART, ⛔ ON THE RECORD — ⛔ the FOURTH time in this section: ⛔ I wrote `TL-§5d`'s false bullet, ⛔ I relayed `+39-never-+1` into four dispatch prompts, and ⛔ I had `handoffs/TASK-814-buildmaster.md:68` — ⛔ the correct figure, ⛔ from the one agent with Git — ⛔ on disk the entire time.** ⇒ ⭐ *⛔ Caught, once again, by ⛔ the one agent who ⛔ ran the instrument* (`cl. 5`).

16. ⛔⛔⛔⭐⭐ **CLAUSE 16 — ⛔ A DISPATCHER'S ⛔ STATED INTENTION IS A ⛔ PLAN, ⛔ NEVER A MEASUREMENT — ⛔ EXACTLY AS A `blocked-by` LIST IS (⛔ cl. 11). ⛔ *"I AM HOLDING X"* AND *"X IS BOARDED BLOCKED-BY Y"* ARE ⛔ TWO DIFFERENT STATES, AND ⛔ NEITHER IS THE TREE.** (added 2026-09-03; 🧑 **the ⛔ ORCHESTRATOR'S and the ⛔ MANAGER'S ⛔ JOINTLY — ⛔ reported by the orchestrator ⛔ against itself, ⛔ unprompted, and ⛔ the manager ⛔ did not re-measure either**)
   - ⛔⛔ **THE MEASURED EVENT, ⛔ AND IT IS ⛔ SMALL ON PURPOSE — ⛔ THE SHAPE IS THE POINT, ⛔ NOT THE COST.** ⛔ The orchestrator said *"I am ⛔ HOLDING the dispatch until `TASK-919`'s build finishes — ⛔ board it now so it cannot be lost."* ⇒ ⛔ **the manager boarded `TASK-933` as ⛔ `blocked-by TASK-925`'s commit.** ⛔ `919` finished, the orchestrator ⛔ dispatched, and the work ⛔ LANDED. ⇒ ⛔⛔ **THE BOARD SAID ⛔ BLOCKED. THE TREE SAID ⛔ DONE. ⛔ Two parties, ⛔ one shared belief, ⛔ zero instruments run.**
   - ⛔ **WHY IT IS ⛔ NOT MERELY cl. 11 AGAIN: ⛔ cl. 11 polices the ⛔ MANAGER'S OWN PROSE about ⛔ downstream deliverables. ⛔ THIS POLICES THE ⛔ SEAM BETWEEN TWO AGENTS — ⛔ a statement of ⛔ FUTURE INTENT that the receiver ⛔ transcribes into ⛔ PRESENT-TENSE BOARD STATE.** ⇒ ⛔ **the intention was ⛔ TRUE WHEN SPOKEN and ⛔ FALSE WITHIN THE HOUR, and ⛔ nothing in the transcription ⛔ carried its expiry.** ⚖️ *⛔ This is `SC-§39.1` cl. 9's ⛔ ANTICIPATORY DESCRIPTION wearing a ⛔ dispatcher's uniform: ⛔ prose that is ⛔ true-then-falsified by an event ⛔ nobody connected back to the row.*
   - ✅ **THE RULE, ⛔ BOTH DIRECTIONS, ⛔ because a one-sided rule here fails:**
     - ⛔ **(a) ⛔ THE DISPATCHER: when an intention ⛔ becomes an action, ⛔ SAY SO TO THE BOARD'S OWNER. ⛔ A dispatch that ⛔ lands is a ⛔ MEASUREMENT and the board is ⛔ entitled to it.** ⛔ *"I dispatched X"* is ⛔ not a courtesy note — it is the ⛔ only event that can ⛔ retire a `blocked-by`.
     - ⛔ **(b) ⛔ THE MANAGER: ⛔ BEFORE BOARDING A ROW WHOSE SUBJECT IS A ⛔ NAMED FILE + A ⛔ NAMED EDIT, ⛔ MEASURE THE FILE.** ⛔ **A one-character repair is ⛔ TEN SECONDS to check and ⛔ CANNOT be checked from a `status:` line.** ⇒ ⛔ **`blocked-by:` carries the ⛔ DATED READ (*"needle still reads `TEXT(\"return; \")` at 2026-09-03"*), ⛔ never the ⛔ dispatcher's plan.**
   - ⛔⛔⭐ **THE ⛔ EXPENSIVE HALF, AND IT IS ⛔ WHY THIS IS A CLAUSE: ⛔ A STALE `blocked-by` DOES ⛔ NOT MERELY IDLE — ⛔ IT ⛔ ARMS A ⛔ STOP CONDITION IN ⛔ SOMEBODY ELSE'S LIVE ROW.** ⛔ **`TASK-925` was dispatched carrying *"⛔ if the repair is ⛔ ALREADY PRESENT ⇒ ⛔ STOP, ⛔ DO NOT STAGE THAT FILE"*, written on the ⛔ correct reasoning that `TASK-934` had not passed.** ⇒ ⛔⛔ **the ⛔ instant the tree changed, a ⛔ RUNNING build-master was ⛔ one measurement away from ⛔ correctly refusing to stage a file the commit ⛔ needed — ⛔ a ⛔ true blocker report caused ⛔ entirely by a ⛔ board row nobody re-read.** ⚖️ ***⛔ THE BOARD IS ⛔ NOT A LEDGER OF WHAT HAPPENED; ⛔ IT IS AN ⛔ INSTRUCTION SET BEING ⛔ EXECUTED BY AGENTS ⛔ RIGHT NOW. ⛔ A STALE ROW IS A ⛔ LIVE FAULT, ⛔ NOT A TIDINESS DEBT.***
   - ⭐ **THE ⛔ CHEAP GENERALISATION, ⛔ worth more than the incident: ⛔ WHEN A ROW IS BOARDED ⛔ SPECIFICALLY SO IT *"CANNOT BE LOST"*, ⛔ THAT IS THE ⛔ EXACT ROW MOST LIKELY TO BE ⛔ DELIVERED OUT OF BAND — ⛔ because the ⛔ same urgency that motivated the boarding motivates the ⛔ dispatch.** ⇒ ⛔ **such a row is ⛔ RE-MEASURED AT ITS ⛔ NEXT TOUCH, ⛔ always, and its ⛔ gate row inherits the same duty.**

17. ⛔⛔⛔⭐⭐ **CLAUSE 17 — ⛔ A PRESCRIPTION COVERS THE ⛔ TEXT IT PRESCRIBES; ⛔ IT NEVER COVERS ⛔ WHAT ARRIVES ⛔ WITH IT. ⛔ *"THAT HUNK IS GATE-PRESCRIBED"* IS A ⛔ CLAIM ABOUT ⛔ PART OF A DIFF, AND IT IS ⛔ ROUTINELY SPOKEN AS THOUGH IT WERE ABOUT ⛔ ALL OF IT.** (added 2026-09-03; 🧑 **the ⛔ MANAGER'S OWN — ⛔ I closed `TASK-934` unrun on exactly this reasoning and wrote that its report *"will ⛔ NEVER EXIST"*. ⛔ The gate was ordered over my closure, ⛔ ran, and ⛔ returned ⛔ THREE corrections. ⛔ FIFTH manager/relay defect in this section.**)
    - ⛔⛔ **THE MEASURED EVENT.** A five-item repair reached `HEAD` in `d101b1e` ⛔ without a gate. ⛔ **The board allowed it on: *"⛔ items (1)–(4) are `qa/TASK-924.md` `W-1`'s ⛔ OWN prescribed remedy applied ⛔ VERBATIM, in the ⛔ SAME FILE that report gated."*** ✅ **⛔ EVERY WORD OF THAT IS ⛔ TRUE, and the gate ⛔ confirmed it independently.** ⛔⛔ **AND IT SAYS ⛔ NOTHING ABOUT ⛔ ITEM (5) — an ⛔ unprescribed 8-line trap comment that ⛔ arrived in the same hunk.** ⇒ ⛔ **`W-1`, `W-2` and `W-3` ⛔ all live in item (5).** ⛔ **The ⛔ covered part was ⛔ flawless; ⛔ 100% of the findings were in the ⛔ uncovered part.**
    - ⛔⛔ **WHY THE SENTENCE IS ⛔ SEDUCTIVE, and it is ⛔ NOT sloppiness: ⛔ IT IS A ⛔ TRUE STATEMENT DOING ⛔ FALSE WORK.** ⛔ **`SC-§46` says a ⛔ compound claim needs ⛔ per-clause evidence; ⛔ THIS is worse — it is a ⛔ SINGLE TRUE CLAIM whose ⛔ SCOPE is silently taken to be the ⛔ whole delivery.** ⇒ ⛔ **a reader who ⛔ checks it ⛔ finds it ⛔ true, ⛔ stops, and the ⛔ unprescribed remainder is ⛔ never examined by ⛔ anyone.** ⚖️ ***⛔ THE MOST DANGEROUS COVERAGE ARGUMENT IS THE ⛔ ONE THAT VERIFIES.***
    - ✅ **THE RULE, ⛔ and it is ⛔ two lines and ⛔ mechanical: ⛔ (a) ⛔ WHEN A HUNK IS DEFENDED AS *"PRESCRIBED"*, ⛔ ENUMERATE WHAT ⛔ SHIPPED AND ⛔ MARK EACH ITEM ⛔ PRESCRIBED OR ⛔ NOT — ⛔ item by item, ⛔ in the row. ⛔ (b) ⛔ IF ⛔ ANY ITEM IS ⛔ UNMARKED OR ⛔ UNPRESCRIBED, THE ⛔ GATE RUNS.** ⛔ **It may run ⛔ CHEAP and ⛔ NARROW — ⛔ the fence is ⛔ the unprescribed part ⛔ alone — but it ⛔ RUNS.**
    - ⛔⛔⭐ **AND THE ⛔ SPECIFIC TEMPTATION THIS CLAUSE EXISTS TO ⛔ REFUSE: *"⛔ IT IS ⛔ ONLY A COMMENT."*** ⛔ **A comment ⛔ genuinely is the ⛔ lowest-risk delta in the repository — ⛔ it cannot compile-break, ⛔ cannot turn a row red, ⛔ cannot reach a player.** ⇒ ⛔ **that is a reason to read it ⛔ CHEAPLY (⛔ this gate cost ⛔ ONE READ), ⛔ NEVER a reason ⛔ not to read it.** ⭐ **The read returned: a ⛔ FALSE UNIVERSAL with its counterexample ⛔ in the same file · a ⛔ FAIL-OPEN discrimination claim · a ⛔ WRONG LAW CITATION ⛔ that had already propagated into a ⛔ dispatch prompt.** ⛔ **In a file whose ⛔ entire doctrine is *"the prose is the guard"*, ⛔ a wrong comment is a ⛔ wrong guard.**
    - ⛔⛔ **THE ⛔ TIMING HALF, ⛔ which is the part that ⛔ cannot be undone: ⛔ A GATE RUN ⛔ AFTER THE COMMIT ⛔ VALIDATES THE ⛔ ARTEFACT AND ⛔ CANNOT VALIDATE THE ⛔ PROCESS.** ⛔ **Its own sentence, ⛔ recorded verbatim because it is the honest form: *"⛔ THE HARD GATE IS NOW SATISFIED FOR THAT HUNK — ⛔ AS OF THIS REPORT, ⛔ NOT AS OF THE COMMIT."*** ⇒ ⛔ **`d101b1e` shipped ⛔ ungated, and the ⛔ ONLY things that make that ⛔ recoverable are that ⛔ `main` was ⛔ UNPUSHED and the gate was ⛔ ACTUALLY RUN.** ⚖️ ***⛔ THE ARTEFACT CAN BE ⛔ RE-MEASURED. ⛔ THE PROCESS CANNOT BE ⛔ RE-RUN.*** ⛔ **An out-of-band delivery ⛔ permanently destroys its ⛔ control transcripts: ⛔ measured, ⛔ glob `*93[0-9]*` = ⛔ ZERO against a ⛔ positive control of ⛔ FIVE — ⛔ there is ⛔ no handoff and there ⛔ never will be.**
    - ⭐⭐ **THE ⛔ POSITIVE HALF, ⛔ AND IT IS THE ⛔ REASON THIS CLAUSE IS ⛔ NOT AN APOLOGY: ⛔ THE RESIDUAL WAS ⛔ FLAGGED FOR JUDGEMENT RATHER THAN ⛔ DECIDED ALONE, and ⛔ that is what let it be ⛔ overruled.** ⛔ **The closure named its own weakest point in writing (*"⛔ item (5) is ⛔ new prose, ⛔ beyond the letter of the prescription"*) ⇒ ⛔ **the orchestrator had ⛔ everything it needed to ⛔ refuse the post-hoc rider and ⛔ order a real gate.** ⇒ ⚖️ ***⛔ NAMING THE PART OF YOUR OWN RULING YOU ARE ⛔ LEAST SURE OF IS WHAT MAKES IT ⛔ CHEAP ENOUGH FOR SOMEBODY TO ⛔ OVERTURN*** (⛔ cl. 10's *"⛔ name your own weakest predicate"*, ⛔ turned on a ⛔ MANAGER RULING instead of on a ⛔ reviewer's task).
    - 🧑 **THE MANAGER'S OWN PART, ⛔ ON THE RECORD — ⛔ FIFTH TIME IN THIS SECTION: ⛔ I wrote *"`qa/TASK-934.md` will ⛔ NEVER EXIST — ⛔ do ⛔ NOT look for it"* into ⛔ THREE rows** (⛔ `934`'s `names:`, ⛔ `937`'s candidate list, ⛔ `937`'s `names:`). ⇒ ⛔ **a ⛔ prediction was written as ⛔ standing instruction, and when the prediction failed it ⛔ armed a ⛔ FALSE BLOCKER in a ⛔ build-master's live row** — ⛔ **the ⛔ identical damage path as ⛔ cl. 16, ⛔ from the ⛔ opposite direction.** ⇒ ⛔ **A BOARD LINE STATES ⛔ WHAT WAS MEASURED, ⛔ NEVER WHAT WILL ⛔ NEVER HAPPEN.** ⭐ *And ⛔ caught, ⛔ again, by the ⛔ one agent who ⛔ opened the file* (⛔ cl. 5).

### SC-§41 ⛔⛔⛔ **A GREP GATE PINS A ⛔ CALL SHAPE, ⛔ NEVER A BARE TOKEN — AND THE ⛔ OPEN PAREN IS THE ⛔ DISCRIMINATOR THAT LETS THE GATE ⛔ HONESTLY SCAN THE FILE IT ⛔ LIVES IN** (added 2026-09-03 — ⛔⛔ **WRITTEN LATE: this section was ⛔ CITED AS SETTLED LAW ⛔ THREE TIMES ⛔ BEFORE IT EXISTED. ⛔ See clause 6.** Bought by `TASK-868` §8's ⛔ needle error, ⛔ disproved by `TASK-882`, ⛔ adjudicated and ⛔ re-measured by `qa/TASK-869.md`)

> 📌⛔⛔ **POINTER, ⛔ ADDED 2026-09-07 — ⛔ READ ⭐ `SC-§101` ⛔ BEFORE YOU IMPLEMENT A PIN SHAPE ⛔ THAT A REPORT HANDED YOU.** ⛔ **A ⛔ prescribed pin is a ⛔ CLAIM, ⛔ not an instruction, and it ⛔ inherits ⛔ NO authority from the finding that prescribed it — ⛔ `qa/TASK-932.md` `W-2` ⛔ correctly diagnosed a ⛔ ONE-SIDED assertion and then ⛔ prescribed a fix that was ⛔ one-sided ⛔ the same way.** ⇒ ⛔ **the acceptance test for ⛔ every shape in this section is ⛔ *"does it ⛔ RED under the named mutation"*, ⛔ NEVER ⛔ *"does it ⛔ match the prescription"*.**

> ### ⚖️⭐⭐ **`SC-§40` cl. 12 says *"pin a call shape, never a bare token"* ⛔ in one line, as ⛔ advice. ⛔ THIS SECTION SAYS ⛔ WHY, AND IT SAYS IT ⛔ BECAUSE THE ONE-LINE FORM WAS ⛔ NOT ENOUGH TO STOP ⛔ FOUR RELAYS OF REAL WORK FROM BEING SPENT ON A ⛔ RED ROW THAT WAS ⛔ NEVER RED.**

1. ⛔⛔ **CLAUSE 1 — THE RULE. ⛔ A SOURCE-SCANNING ASSERTION PINS `Symbol(` (⛔ or `Symbol =`), ⛔ NEVER `Symbol`.** ⛔ **The open paren is ⛔ not punctuation — it is a ⛔ SEMANTIC DISCRIMINATOR that separates a ⛔ CALL from ⛔ PROSE.** ⇒ ⛔ **a bare-token lane counts the guard's own test names, its own `TEXT(…)` failure messages, its own comments and its own docstrings, ⛔ and every one of those is a ⛔ FALSE POSITIVE that ⛔ nobody can distinguish from the real thing at a distance.**
2. ⭐⭐ **CLAUSE 2 — THE DIVIDEND, ⛔ AND IT IS THE REASON THIS IS A SECTION AND NOT A NIT: ⛔ A CALL-SHAPE LANE ⛔ DOES NOT EXPIRE, AND IT CAN ⛔ SCAN THE FILE IT LIVES IN.** ⛔ **A bare-token lane goes ⛔ RED on a ⛔ REWORDED FAILURE MESSAGE ⇒ it must ⛔ either exclude its own file (⛔ deleting coverage) ⛔ or be ⛔ re-pinned every time somebody edits prose (⛔ which is how a guard gets ⛔ loosened by the next person in a hurry).** ⇒ ⛔ **the call shape buys ⛔ self-coverage and ⛔ prose-immunity ⛔ with the same character.**
3. ⛔⛔⛔ **CLAUSE 3 — ⛔ NEVER EXCLUDE THE GATE'S OWN FILE FROM ITS OWN LANE. ⛔ MEASURED, ⛔ NOT ARGUED.** ⛔ **On `SiegeAcquisitionFunnelTest.cpp`'s three lanes: lane A sees ⛔ ONLY the `UGameplayStatics::`-qualified form; lane B is ⛔ SHIPPING-SCOPED.** ⇒ ⛔⛔ **`Tests/` is covered by ⛔ LANE C ALONE, so excluding the gate's own file would leave a ⛔ REAL BARE ENUMERATION written ⛔ INSIDE THE GATE ⛔ VISIBLE TO NO LANE AT ALL.** ⛔ **The exclusion is the ⛔ intuitive repair and it is the ⛔ one that opens the hole.**
4. 🪤⛔⛔ **CLAUSE 4 — THE TRAP THE DISCRIMINATOR CREATES, ⛔ AND IT MUST BE WRITTEN INTO ⛔ EVERY SPEC THAT EDITS A GATE'S OWN TEXT: ⛔ A `TEXT(…)` THAT SPELLS THE TOKEN ⛔ WITH AN OPEN PAREN, ⛔ ON A CODE LINE, ⛔ COUNTS.** ⛔ **That is ⛔ NOT a defect — it is ⛔ exactly why the pin is `1` and not `0`.** ⇒ ⛔ **whoever writes prose inside a scanned file ⛔ names the open paren ⛔ DESCRIPTIVELY and ⛔ never spells it** (⭐ **working precedent: `SiegeAcquisitionFunnelTest.cpp:621` quotes the token ⛔ paren-less inside a `TEXT(…)` and counts ⛔ zero**). ⛔ **A "documentation-only" edit that spells `Symbol(` turns a ⛔ commit-blocking gate ⛔ RED.**
5. ⛔⛔⭐ **CLAUSE 5 — THE DIAGNOSTIC THAT MATTERS MOST, ⛔ AND THE ONE THIS EVENT ACTUALLY BOUGHT: ⛔ A ⛔ NEEDLE ERROR IS ⛔ NOT A COUNTING ERROR, AND ⛔ RECORDING IT AS ONE TEACHES THE ⛔ WRONG LESSON.** ⛔ **`TASK-868`'s `3` was ⛔ ARITHMETICALLY CORRECT and ⛔ reproduces exactly on two independent replicas — it counted the ⛔ PAREN-LESS token. ⛔ The shipped lane counts the ⛔ WITH-PAREN one.** ⇒ ⛔ **the replica was ⛔ right about everything except ⛔ WHICH STRING IT WAS COUNTING, and ⛔ nine agreeing figures could ⛔ not reveal that.**
   - ✅ **THE OPERATIONAL FORM: ⛔ a replica of a shipped scan is validated by ⛔ QUOTING THE SHIPPED NEEDLE'S ⛔ CONSTRUCTION SITE AND ITS ⛔ CONSUMPTION SITE, ⛔ not by agreeing with the original's ⛔ other numbers.** ⛔ **Two replicas built from the same reading ⛔ share the same defect; ⛔ agreement on unrelated figures ⛔ LOCALISES a fault to the needle, it ⛔ does not settle which needle ships.** ⭐ **What settled it was ⛔ reading lines 276 and 312 and ⛔ counting the tree** (`SC-§40` cl. 5: ⛔ the one reader who opens the file beats every reader who reasons about it).
6. 🧑⚖️⛔⛔ **CLAUSE 6 — THE ⛔ PHANTOM CITATION, ⛔ ON THE RECORD, ⛔ BECAUSE IT IS THIS SECTION'S ⛔ FIRST AND ⛔ SHARPEST EXHIBIT: ⛔ `SC-§41` WAS CITED AS ⛔ EXISTING LAW BY ⛔ THREE ARTEFACTS ⛔ BEFORE A SINGLE WORD OF IT WAS WRITTEN.** ⛔ **`TASK-882`'s spec (*"written for exactly this defect class — ⛔ read it, ⛔ do not restate it"*), `TASK-869`'s `names:` line, and `handoffs/TASK-882-programmer.md` §5.** ⛔ **`grep "SC-§41"` over `CONVENTIONS.md` returned ⛔ ZERO.** 🧑 **THE MANAGER WROTE ALL THREE CITATIONS AND ⛔ NEVER WROTE THE LAW.**
   - ⇒ ⭐⭐ **THIS IS `SC-§40` ⛔ ONE LEVEL UP: cl. 3 governs a ⛔ FACT relayed as settled; ⛔ THIS is a ⛔ LAW relayed as settled, ⛔ by the one agent who ⛔ owns the law file, and ⛔ nobody opened it.** ⛔ **The programmer was told *"read it, do not restate it"* — ⛔ the one instruction that ⛔ guarantees the absence stays invisible — and ⛔ derived the right answer anyway.** ⛔ **The gate found it.**
   - ✅ **THE RULE, ⛔ and it is cheap: ⛔ THE MANAGER GREPS `CONVENTIONS.md` FOR EVERY `§` IT CITES IN A `spec:` OR `names:` LINE ⛔ BEFORE THE ROW SHIPS.** ⛔ **A citation is a ⛔ promise that a reader can go and read something; ⛔ *"cited, not restated"* makes that promise ⛔ load-bearing and ⛔ unfalsifiable in the same sentence.** ⚖️ *⛔ A law that does not exist is ⛔ indistinguishable, to its reader, from a law it is ⛔ not allowed to paraphrase.*
7. ⚖️ **CLAUSE 7 — SCOPE. ⛔ This binds ⛔ source-text assertions (grep gates, census tests, name/registry walks). ⛔ It does ⛔ NOT ask anyone to re-pin behavioural tests, and it does ⛔ NOT license loosening a pin: ⛔ the pin stays ⛔ EXACT (`==`), ⛔ always. ⛔ What changes is ⛔ WHAT IS COUNTED, ⛔ never HOW TIGHTLY.**

8. ⛔⛔⭐⭐ **CLAUSE 8 — ⛔ A NEEDLE IS ANCHORED ON THE SIDE WHERE THE ⛔ COLLISION LIVES. ⛔ WHEN THE COLLISION IS ⛔ ANOTHER IDENTIFIER, ⛔ PIN THE ⛔ SYNTACTIC ROLE, ⛔ NEVER THE NAME.** (added 2026-09-03; ⛔ bought by `TASK-860`, ⛔ ruled in by `qa/TASK-862.md`. 📌 **The gate proposed this as *"cl. 7"*; ⛔ cl. 7 was ⛔ already SCOPE — ⛔ the manager ⛔ GREPPED `CONVENTIONS.md` BEFORE PLACING IT, per ⛔ cl. 6's own rule. ⛔ Cite it as ⛔ CLAUSE 8.**)
   - ⛔⛔ **WHY IT IS ⛔ GENUINELY NEW AND ⛔ NOT A RESTATEMENT.** ⛔ **`SC-§39`'s two recorded directions are a ⛔ leading `/*` that ⛔ HIDES a real hit and a ⛔ trailing `//` that ⛔ MANUFACTURES a false one — ⛔ both are ⛔ COMMENT-vs-CODE confusions. ⛔ Clause 1's open paren separates a ⛔ CALL from ⛔ PROSE.** ⇒ ⛔ **NEITHER COVERS THIS.** ⛔ **`CastPercent` inside `ProviderCastPercent` is ⛔ not a comment, ⛔ not prose, and ⛔ not a call — it is a ⛔ REAL IDENTIFIER ON A ⛔ REAL CODE LINE, and ⛔ every clause in the book reads it as a ⛔ legitimate hit ⛔ BECAUSE IT IS ONE.** ⛔ **The open-paren discriminator sits on the ⛔ WRONG SIDE OF THE TOKEN and buys ⛔ nothing here.**
   - ⛔ **THE MEASURED EVENT.** ⛔ **Banning the bare word `CastPercent` in `CombatantHealthBarComponent.h` would have been ⛔ RED ON ARRIVAL: ⛔ 3 hits on ⛔ 2 CODE lines, as a substring of the ⛔ shipped parameter names `ProviderCastPercent` / `RawCastPercent`.** ⭐ **`TASK-860` ⛔ greppied its own needle before shipping it, and that is the ⛔ only reason the row is ⛔ green instead of red.**
   - ✅ **THE RULE, ⛔ in four parts:**
     1. ⛔ **BEFORE SHIPPING ANY ABSENCE NEEDLE, ⛔ GREP IT AND ⛔ READ THE HITS.** ⛔ *"I picked a token nothing should match"* is ⛔ NOT EVIDENCE (⛔ `SC-§40` cl. 10's shape, ⛔ applied to needles rather than to constants).
     2. ⛔⛔ **IF THE BANNED TOKEN IS A ⛔ LEGITIMATE SUBSTRING OF A ⛔ SHIPPED IDENTIFIER, ⛔ NO AMOUNT OF ⛔ TRIMMING THE TOKEN HELPS ⛔ AND `Symbol(` DOES ⛔ NOT EITHER.** ⇒ ⛔ **RE-POINT THE NEEDLE AT THE ⛔ ROLE: ⛔ `Name;` / `Name =` for a ⛔ MEMBER · ⛔ `Name,` / `Name)` for a ⛔ PARAMETER · ⛔ `Name(` for a ⛔ CALL.** ⛔ **Banning the ⛔ ROLE rather than the ⛔ NAME is what makes the ban ⛔ immune to any identifier that merely ⛔ CONTAINS the word.**
     3. ⛔ **CARRY A POSITIVE CONTROL ⛔ OF THAT SAME ROLE, ⛔ IN THAT SAME FILE** — ⛔ here `Accumulator = 0.f;` == **2**, which proves the ⛔ role-anchored needle can ⛔ still see a real member. ⛔ **Without it, the two zeros are ⛔ INDISTINGUISHABLE from a needle that ⛔ matches nothing** (`SC-§39`).
     4. ⚖️ **WHY THIS IS WORTH A CLAUSE RATHER THAN A NOTE: ⛔ THE FAILURE IS ⛔ SILENT IN THE ⛔ SAFE-LOOKING DIRECTION AT ⛔ AUTHORING TIME AND ⛔ LOUD IN THE ⛔ WRONG PLACE AT ⛔ RUN TIME.** ⛔ **A bare-word ban goes red in a test named for a ⛔ STORED-TELL BAN, ⛔ naming neither the substring nor the parameter — and the ⛔ obvious "fix" is to ⛔ DELETE THE BAN.** ⭐ *⛔ Same terminal shape as clause 5 and as `SC-§39.1` cl. 6's crash rider: ⛔ every one of these defects ends with a ⛔ well-meaning reader ⛔ removing a guard.*

9. ⛔⛔⭐⭐ **CLAUSE 9 — ⛔ THE LAW ⛔ WORKED, AND THE ⛔ DIVIDEND IS THAT ⛔ BOTH NUMBERS NOW HAVE A ⛔ NAMED NEEDLE INSTEAD OF ⛔ ONE NUMBER HAVING A ⛔ REPUTATION.** (added 2026-09-03, from `TASK-852` + `qa/TASK-856.md`'s ruling — ⛔ **the first time this section ⛔ PREVENTED a phantom rather than ⛔ explaining one after the fact**)
   - ⛔ **THE MEASUREMENT, ⛔ BOTH HALVES, ⛔ on `SiegeControlsHelpWidget.cpp`:** ⛔ the ⛔ **ASSIGNMENT SHAPE** `\.RelatedActionIds\s*=` returns ⛔ **16** · a ⛔ **BARE** `grep "RelatedActionIds"` returns ⛔ **23**. ⇒ ⛔ **The difference is ⛔ FULLY ACCOUNTED: ⛔ 6 comment lines + ⛔ 1 consumption site (`Content.Related.Reserve(Row.RelatedActionIds.Num())`).** ⛔ **`16 + 6 + 1 = 23`; ⛔ nothing is narrated away** (`SC-§29b`).
   - ⭐⭐ **THE DIVIDEND, ⛔ AND IT IS THE POINT: ⛔ `SC-§41` PRODUCED ⛔ NO PHANTOM `+7`.** ⛔ **A reader who took the ⛔ obvious needle would have reported the count as having ⛔ grown from 13 to 23 and *"repaired"* a shipped comment to say ⛔ 23 — ⛔ a number that is ⛔ wrong in a ⛔ NEW way, ⛔ derived from a ⛔ correctly-run grep.**
   - ✅ **THE OPERATIONAL RULE THIS ADDS: ⛔ WHEN A LAW SAYS *"the obvious needle is wrong"*, ⛔ IT MUST ALSO RECORD ⛔ WHAT THE OBVIOUS NEEDLE ⛔ RETURNS ⛔ AND ⛔ WHY.** ⛔ **Naming only the ⛔ right number leaves the next reader unable to tell *"I used the wrong needle"* from *"the count changed since the law was written"* — ⛔ two conditions with ⛔ opposite responses.** ⇒ ⛔ **Publish the ⛔ PAIR and the ⛔ RECONCILIATION, ⛔ never the winner alone.**
   - ⚖️ ***⛔ A number without a needle is a ⛔ RUMOUR. ⛔ Two numbers with two needles and an ⛔ arithmetic bridge between them is a ⛔ MEASUREMENT — ⛔ and only the second survives being ⛔ re-taken by someone else.***

### SC-§42 ⛔⛔⛔ **A ⛔ HANDLED EVENT IS ⛔ NOT AN ⛔ ACTIONED EVENT — AND WHEN THE FACT DOES ⛔ NOT LIVE IN A FILE, ⛔ NO AMOUNT OF READING CLOSES IT** (added 2026-09-03; bought by `qa/TASK-816.md` W-1, ⛔ reasoned toward by ⛔ THREE independent readers, ⛔ settled by ⛔ ONE CLICK OF JONATHAN'S)

> ### ⚖️⭐⭐ **`SC-§40` cl. 5 says *"the one reader who opens the file beats every reader who reasons about it."* ⛔ THIS SECTION IS ITS ⛔ CEILING: ⛔ HERE ⛔ EVERY READER OPENED THE FILE, ⛔ ALL THREE AGREED, ⛔ AND ⛔ NONE OF THEM COULD ⛔ CONFIRM IT.**

1. ⛔⛔ **CLAUSE 1 — THE RULE, ⛔ IN ONE LINE: ⛔ `FReply::Handled()` MEANS *"⛔ THE ROUTER MAY STOP HERE"*. ⛔ IT DOES ⛔ NOT MEAN *"⛔ THE CONSUMER DID SOMETHING"*, AND IT DOES ⛔ NOT MEAN *"⛔ NOTHING DOWNSTREAM RUNS"*.** ⛔ **A `Handled` reply is a ⛔ ROUTING DECLARATION, ⛔ not a ⛔ BEHAVIOURAL ONE.** ⇒ ⛔ **reading `return FReply::Handled();` at the top of a handler tells you ⛔ what the widget CLAIMS about the event, ⛔ never what the ⛔ PLAYER SEES.**
2. ⛔ **THE MEASURED EVENT, ⛔ AND IT IS THE WHOLE EXHIBIT.** ⛔ **Two shipped help rows contradicted each other about ⛔ one gesture in ⛔ one mode** (`Interface.WarMap`: *"closed by right-click or Escape, polled every frame"*; `Interface.MapMarks`: *"a right-click that hits no circle does nothing at all"*). ⛔ **`WarMapWidget.cpp`'s `NativeOnMouseButtonDown` returns `FReply::Handled()` on ⛔ EVERY RMB while the map is open** ⇒ ⛔ **`TASK-818`, `qa/TASK-816.md` and the manager ⛔ each independently reasoned that the poll must therefore be ⛔ unreachable and the `WarMap` row false.**
   - ✅⭐⭐ **THEY WERE ⛔ RIGHT — ⛔ AND THE REASONING IS ⛔ NOT WHAT MADE IT TRUE.** 🧑 **JONATHAN'S OWN WORDS, 2026-09-03, ⛔ ONE CLICK:** > *"opening the war map and right clicking empty ground does not cause it to close, the map seems to function exactly as it should"* ⇒ ⛔ **`Interface.MapMarks` is ⛔ TRUE (`TASK-823` wrote it correctly); ⛔ `Interface.WarMap` is the ⛔ FALSE ONE.** ⛔ **`TASK-870`'s target is now ⛔ DETERMINED, ⛔ not conditional.**
   - ⚠️ **CORROBORATION, ⛔ NAMED SO IT IS ⛔ NOT MISTAKEN FOR THE PROOF: ⛔ `WR-§9` cl. 1 ⛔ already said *"the RIGHT button still does nothing on empty map"* — ⛔ but that clause is about ⛔ MARK CREATION, ⛔ not about CLOSING, so it ⛔ agreed without ⛔ settling. ⛔ A law that ⛔ nearly answers a question is ⛔ not an answer.**
3. ⛔⛔⭐ **CLAUSE 3 — THE OPERATIONAL RULE, AND IT IS THE ⛔ POINT OF WRITING THIS DOWN: ⛔ WHEN A QUESTION TURNS ON ⛔ SLATE EVENT ROUTING UNDER A ⛔ LIVE INPUT MODE, IT IS AN ⛔ OBSERVATION, ⛔ NOT A DEDUCTION — ⛔ AND THE CORRECT ACTION IS TO ⛔ BOARD A ONE-CLICK PIE ROW, ⛔ NOT TO READ HARDER.** ⛔ **Reading harder is ⛔ free and ⛔ feels like progress and ⛔ cannot terminate.** ⭐ **The instrument that settled a two-day contradiction cost ⛔ one click and ⛔ one sentence.**
   - ⛔ **The ⛔ same rule binds ⛔ agreement: ⛔ THREE readers converging is ⛔ CONFIDENCE, ⛔ never CONFIRMATION** (`SC-§41` cl. 5's shape: ⛔ agreement ⛔ localises, it does ⛔ not settle). ⛔ **Convergence on an unobservable is ⛔ exactly the state in which a wrong answer ships fastest.**
4. ⚖️ **CLAUSE 4 — SCOPE.** ⛔ **This does ⛔ NOT retire `CARDBAR-§6`'s never-`Handled` rule — ⛔ that rule stands, ⛔ absolutely, and ⛔ this section is its ⛔ evidentiary counterpart: ⛔ `§6` governs what you ⛔ WRITE; ⛔ `SC-§42` governs what you may ⛔ CONCLUDE from what somebody else wrote.** ⛔ **A `Handled` reply is ⛔ still a real hazard to a downstream poll — ⛔ it is ⛔ merely not a ⛔ MEASUREMENT that the poll was pre-empted.**

### SC-§43 ⛔⛔⛔ **WHEN A WHOLE-FILE COMMIT CARRIES WORK FROM A LANE WHOSE GATE ⛔ CANNOT RUN — ⛔ SPLIT THE ⛔ GATE. ⛔ NEVER THE ⛔ FILE, AND ⛔ NEVER HOLD THE ⛔ READY LANE.** (added 2026-09-03; ⛔ ruled by the manager ⛔ BEFORE dispatch, after the ⛔ same class stopped `TASK-814` mid-commit and cost ⛔ TWO escalations)

> ### ⛔⛔ **THE SHAPE, ⛔ ONCE, SO IT IS ⛔ RECOGNISED THE ⛔ THIRD TIME: ⛔ A COMMIT TAKES ⛔ WHOLE FILES. ⛔ A GATE COVERS ⛔ NAMED TASKS. ⛔ WHEN ⛔ ONE FILE HOLDS ⛔ TWO LANES AND ⛔ ONE LANE'S GATE IS ⛔ BLOCKED, THE ⛔ COMMIT IS ⛔ STUCK AND ⛔ NOBODY OWNS THE PROBLEM.**

1. ⛔⛔ **CLAUSE 1 — IT IS THE ⛔ MANAGER'S TO RULE, ⛔ BEFORE DISPATCH, ⛔ WRITTEN ON THE ROWS.** ⛔ **Leaving it for a build-master to discover ⛔ mid-commit has now cost ⛔ two escalations** (⛔ `TASK-814`'s funnel-test pathspec; ⛔ `TASK-835`'s `SiegeCombatStatics`). ⚖️ *⛔ The build-master ⛔ correctly refused both times — ⛔ but a gate ⛔ working is ⛔ not a reason to keep spending it, and the ⛔ second one was ⛔ predictable from the first.*
2. ✅ **CLAUSE 2 — THE ⛔ THREE OPTIONS, ⛔ RANKED, ⛔ WITH THE REASONS:**
   - ⭐⭐ **(a) ⛔ SPLIT THE GATE — ⛔ THE ANSWER.** ⛔ **Board a ⛔ NEW gate over the ⛔ stuck task ⛔ ALONE and ⛔ RESCOPE the original to its ⛔ remaining subjects.** ⛔ **This is `SC-§29`'s coverage ledger used as a ⛔ TOOL rather than merely obeyed: ⛔ a gate covers the tasks it ⛔ NAMES, so ⛔ RE-NAMING is the ⛔ legitimate instrument.** ⛔ **Nothing is dropped — ⛔ the subject is gated ⛔ by name, ⛔ elsewhere.**
   - ⛔ **(b) ⛔ HOLD THE READY LANE — ⛔ REFUSED unless the blocker has a ⛔ DATE.** ⛔ **Hostaging a lane whose ⛔ own gates all PASSED to a ruling with ⛔ no deadline converts a ⛔ scheduling problem into an ⛔ indefinite one, and ⛔ the finished work rots in a working tree** (⛔ where `TL-§5d` can lose it).
   - ⛔⛔ **(c) ⛔ SPLIT THE FILE — ⛔ THE WORST OPTION AND ⛔ ALMOST ALWAYS WRONG.** ⛔ **Hunk-picking is ⛔ exactly what the whole-file law forbids; ⛔ a shared funnel is ⛔ one unit ⛔ by design; and ⛔ tearing a diff out and back ⛔ turns count-pins red for ⛔ purely clerical reasons.** ⛔ **If the file ⛔ genuinely holds two unrelated things, that is a ⛔ DESIGN finding to board, ⛔ not a commit-time manoeuvre.**
3. ⛔⛔⛔⭐⭐ **CLAUSE 3 — THE ⛔ PRICE OF SPLITTING THE GATE, AND IT IS ⛔ NOT OPTIONAL: ⛔ THE SHIPPED-EARLY DIFF MUST BE ⛔ INERT, AND ⛔ ITS INERTNESS IS ⛔ VERIFIED BY ⛔ TWO PARTIES, ⛔ INDEPENDENTLY.**
   - ⛔ **The new gate verifies it ⛔ by reading; the ⛔ build-master verifies it ⛔ again before committing, ⛔ because the build-master is the ⛔ IRREVERSIBLE step.**
   - ⛔⛔ **AND THE REASON ⛔ TWO READERS ARE OWED HERE AND ⛔ NOWHERE ELSE: ⛔ *"nothing happens"* is ⛔ EXACTLY what a ⛔ correctly-inert diff and a ⛔ silently-live one ⛔ both look like from outside.** ⇒ ⛔ **the author's own sentence (*"it does nothing at runtime"*) is ⛔ THE CLAIM UNDER TEST, ⛔ never the evidence for it** (`SC-§40` cl. 1).
   - ⛔ **If inertness ⛔ cannot be established, ⛔ option (a) is ⛔ off the table and the ruling ⛔ falls back to (b).** ⛔ **An inert-by-hope diff shipping early is ⛔ how a lane nobody designed goes live.**
4. ⛔⛔🪤 **CLAUSE 4 — THE ⛔ COMPANION TRAP THAT RIDES WITH EVERY ONE OF THESE RULINGS, AND IT IS WHAT ⛔ ACTUALLY STOPPED `TASK-814`: ⛔ THE FILE YOU ADD MAY ⛔ CALL SYMBOLS THAT ARE ⛔ NOT AT `HEAD`.**
   - ✅ **BEFORE COMMITTING BY PATHSPEC: ⛔ CONFIRM NO SYMBOL YOU ARE COMMITTING RESOLVES INTO A FILE YOU ARE ⛔ EXCLUDING.** ⛔ **Otherwise the ⛔ intermediate `HEAD` ⛔ DOES NOT COMPILE — and ⛔ neither build measures that, because ⛔ BOTH compile the ⛔ WORKING TREE, ⛔ never `HEAD`.**
   - ⭐ **MEASURED TWICE IN ⛔ ONE DAY, ⛔ same shape, ⛔ opposite directions:** ⛔ `Tests/SiegeAcquisitionFunnelTest.cpp` calls `FSiegeCombatStatics::{IsHostileTeam,GatherHostileAgents,GatherFriendlyAgents}` — ⛔ **ZERO occurrences at `HEAD`** ⇒ ⛔ **REMOVED from `TASK-814`** · ⛔ `SiegeCombatStatics.cpp` calls `FSiegeFogStatics::EffectiveVisionRadius` ⇒ ⛔ **`SiegeFogStatics.{h,cpp}` ADDED to `TASK-835`.** ⚖️ *⛔ Same law, ⛔ once subtracting and ⛔ once adding — ⛔ which is why it is a ⛔ CHECK, ⛔ not a habit of trimming.*
5. ⚖️ **CLAUSE 5 — AND A ⛔ TEST FILE ⛔ ALWAYS TRAVELS WITH THE ⛔ CODE IT COVERS** (`TL-§5d` cl. 3). ⛔ **That single rule is what ⛔ generates a commit host automatically and ⛔ prevents the orphan class outright** — ⛔ it is ⛔ not tidiness, it is the ⛔ mechanism.

### SC-§44 ⛔⛔⛔ **A ⛔ GREEN TEST THAT ASSERTS A ⛔ DEGRADE PATH RETURNS ⛔ EMPTY MAKES THE ⛔ WHOLE SUITE ⛔ BLIND TO THAT FEATURE'S ⛔ TOTAL FAILURE — ⛔ AND THE FAILURE LOOKS ⛔ TIDY** (added 2026-09-03, from `Siegebound.CardHand.SlotKeyLabelDegradesToEmptyNeverAPlaceholder` on a `426 / 0` suite)

> ### ⛔⛔ **THE PASSING SUITE WAS ⛔ FULLY CONSISTENT WITH ⛔ EVERY KEY CHIP IN THE GAME BEING ⛔ BLANK. ⛔ SIX MISSING CHIPS AND ⛔ SIX CORRECT-BUT-INVISIBLE ONES ARE ⛔ THE SAME PIXELS AS *"THE BUTTONS CAME OUT NICELY."***

1. ⛔ **THE MECHANISM.** ⛔ **A ⛔ degrade-open surface is ⛔ correct design** — ⛔ a label resolver that ⛔ cannot reach its source returns ⛔ EMPTY rather than a ⛔ placeholder, and ⛔ a test rightly ⛔ pins that. ⇒ ⛔⛔ **but the ⛔ SAME empty is produced by ⛔ TOTAL RESOLVER DEATH, and the ⛔ suite asserts the empty is ⛔ CORRECT.** ⛔ **The test is ⛔ not wrong. ⛔ The inference from its green is.**
2. ⛔⛔ **WHY IT IS ⛔ WORSE THAN AN ORDINARY COVERAGE HOLE: ⛔ THE ⛔ FAILED STATE IS ⛔ AESTHETICALLY INDISTINGUISHABLE FROM THE ⛔ INTENDED ONE.** ⛔ **A bar with ⛔ no chips reads as ⛔ CLEAN. ⛔ Nobody reports it, ⛔ nothing goes red, and the ⛔ feature is simply ⛔ absent.** ⚖️ *⛔ Same family as the ⛔ empty-log-reads-as-a-zero-offset law: ⛔ the failure lies in the ⛔ REASSURING direction.*
3. ✅ **THE RULE, ⛔ TWO PARTS:**
   - ⛔ **(a) ⛔ WHEREVER A SUITE PINS A ⛔ DEGRADE-TO-EMPTY, THE ⛔ PIXEL ROW MUST DEMAND THE ⛔ CONTENT, ⛔ NOT THE ⛔ TIDINESS.** ⛔ **Report ⛔ WHAT THE LABEL SAYS, ⛔ character by character. ⛔ *"It looks right"* is ⛔ not an answer and ⛔ never was** (`AS-§6` A(e), `VIS-§4`).
   - ⛔⛔ **(b) ⛔ THE ⛔ ABSENCE OF THE SURFACE IS A ⛔ FAILURE, ⛔ AND THE PLAYTEST SHEET MUST ⛔ SAY SO IN THOSE WORDS ⛔ BEFORE THE SESSION.** ⛔ **Otherwise the ⛔ human instrument — the ⛔ only one that can see it — ⛔ scores the defect as a ⛔ pass.**
4. ⚖️ **SCOPE — this is ⛔ NOT an argument for placeholders.** ⛔ **Degrade-open stays the law** (a `?` chip that ships is ⛔ worse than a blank one). ⭐ **What changes is ⛔ what a green suite ⛔ ENTITLES you to conclude, and ⛔ who is told what to look for.**
5. ✅✅⭐⭐ **FIRST CLOSURE — 2026-09-03, 🧑 JONATHAN'S OWN EYE: *"all the cards on the screen are numbered correctly 1 through 6."*** ⇒ ⛔ **ALL SIX CHIPS RENDER. ⛔ THE DEGRADE-OPEN FAILURE ⛔ DID NOT FIRE, and the ⛔ label resolver ⛔ DOES reach the controller at runtime.** ⭐ **It is the payoff of a chain that cost ⛔ two build attempts and ⛔ a whole gate:** `TASK-807` wrote `GetSlotKeyLabel` to source · ⛔ the running editor held a ⛔ STALE DLL so it was ⛔ absent from the palette · `TASK-824` failed once on a ⛔ comment terminator, then put ⛔ `GetSlotKeyLabel` ⛔ AND its `execGetSlotKeyLabel` ⛔ UHT thunk in the binary · `TASK-809` built the chips against it · `TASK-811` shipped the widget.
   ⛔⛔ **AND THE ⛔ ONE READING THAT MUST ⛔ NOT BE TAKEN FROM THIS: ⛔ *"the tests were sufficient after all."* ⛔ THEY WERE ⛔ NOT AND ⛔ COULD NOT BE.** ⛔ **`Siegebound.CardHand.SlotKeyLabelDegradesToEmptyNeverAPlaceholder` is ⛔ GREEN EITHER WAY** ⇒ ⛔ **the blindness was ⛔ REAL, was ⛔ DECLARED IN ADVANCE, and was resolved by the ⛔ ONLY INSTRUMENT THAT COULD RESOLVE IT — ⛔ a person looking.** ⚖️ *⭐ That is this section ⛔ working exactly as written: ⛔ it named the hole, ⛔ told the human what to look for in ⛔ his terms, and ⛔ the human closed it. ⛔ A closure is ⛔ evidence FOR the law, ⛔ never a repeal of it.*

### SC-§45 ⛔⛔⛔ **A ⛔ PROSE FIGURE SITTING ⛔ BESIDE THE VALUE IT DESCRIBES WILL BE ⛔ READ INSTEAD OF THE VALUE — AND A ⛔ SINGLE-CELL SCOPE FENCE PROTECTS THE ⛔ NUMBER WHILE ⛔ ORPHANING ITS ⛔ DESCRIPTION** (added 2026-09-03, from `qa/TASK-908.md` NIT-1; ⛔ **the FIRST instance found in ⛔ GAME DATA rather than in code or a document**, and its ⛔ root cause is ⛔ traced to `TASK-237`)

> ### ⛔⛔ **`FOG-§7` ENUMERATED ⛔ SIX AoE CARDS AND THERE ARE ⛔ SEVEN. ⛔ THE MISSING ONE IS THE ⛔ ONLY ONE THAT MATTERS — AND IT WAS MISSED BECAUSE ITS ⛔ `Notes` COLUMN SAYS *"in 400"* WHILE ITS ⛔ `AoERadius` COLUMN SAYS ⛔ `700`.**

1. ⛔ **THE MEASURED CASE.** ⛔ `Docs/Data/cards.csv` row `Lightning`: ⛔ **`AoERadius = 700`**, ⛔ `Notes` ⛔ *"…in 400 castle excluded"*. ⛔ **Every other AoE card's prose ⛔ agrees with its data** (Sapper 250/250 · BombTower 250/250 · Fireball 300/300 · FrostNova 350/350 · BattleCry 400/400) ⇒ ⛔ **`Lightning` is the ⛔ ONE row where a reader checking the ⛔ human-readable column is ⛔ wrong by 300 uu — and it is the ⛔ ONE row above the 609.6 fog ceiling.**
2. ⛔⛔⭐⭐ **THE ROOT CAUSE, ⛔ TRACED RATHER THAN GUESSED, AND IT IS THE ⛔ REASON THIS IS A LAW AND ⛔ NOT A TYPO: ⛔ `TASK-237` (2026-07-21, ⛔ committed `c2b2f59`) ⛔ DELIBERATELY RAISED `AoERadius` ⛔ 400 → 700 UNDER AN ⛔ EXPLICIT *"single-cell diff; ⛔ other cells frozen (git-diff confinement)"* ⛔ ACCEPTANCE.** ⇒ ⛔ **THE FENCE WORKED ⛔ EXACTLY AS WRITTEN. ⛔ It froze the ⛔ `Notes` cell ⛔ TOO — and ⛔ 45 days later a law was written from the ⛔ frozen cell.** ⚖️ *⛔ A scope fence that ⛔ protects a value from ⛔ collateral edits also ⛔ protects the ⛔ SENTENCE THAT CONTRADICTS IT. ⛔ The narrower the diff, the ⛔ more certainly the prose is ⛔ left behind.*
3. ✅ **THE RULE, ⛔ THREE PARTS:**
   - ⛔ **(a) ⛔ WHEN A TASK CHANGES A ⛔ SHIPPED VALUE, THE ⛔ PROSE BESIDE IT — ⛔ `Notes` cell, ⛔ trailing comment, ⛔ doc row — IS ⛔ INSIDE THE FENCE, ⛔ NOT OUTSIDE IT.** ⛔ **A single-cell acceptance must read *"the cell ⛔ AND its description"*.** ⭐ **This is ⛔ not scope creep: ⛔ the description is ⛔ part of the value's ⛔ definition.**
   - ⛔⛔ **(b) ⛔ A LAW, SPEC OR ENUMERATION DERIVED FROM DATA IS ⛔ TAKEN FROM THE ⛔ MACHINE-READ COLUMN, ⛔ NEVER FROM THE ⛔ PROSE COLUMN — ⛔ and it ⛔ SAYS WHICH COLUMN IT READ.** ⛔ **`FOG-§7`'s six-card enumeration is the ⛔ worked example of the failure: ⛔ it was ⛔ complete against the prose and ⛔ short by one against the data.**
   - ⛔ **(c) ⛔ WHEN THE TWO DISAGREE, THE ⛔ SHIPPED VALUE IS THE ⛔ TRUTH AND THE ⛔ PROSE IS THE ⛔ DEFECT** — ⛔ the value is what the ⛔ GAME does. ⚠️ ⛔ **REPAIR THE PROSE. ⛔ DO ⛔ NOT "reconcile" by ⛔ changing the value: ⛔ that is a ⛔ BALANCE CHANGE wearing a ⛔ typo fix's clothes**, and it ⛔ needs 🧑 Jonathan.
4. ⚖️⭐ **AND THE ⛔ CROSS-DOMAIN POINT, ⛔ which is why this sits in `SC-§` rather than in a data section: ⛔ THIS IS THE ⛔ SAME SPECIES AS the ⛔ *"~3×"* comment over a ⛔ 305× ratio, the ⛔ `SiegeFogStatics.h:96` paragraph claiming ⛔ ONE `304.8` beside a ⛔ SECOND one, and the ⛔ test banner asserting *"synthetic 700"* over a ⛔ derived 1219.2.** ⛔ **Three found in ⛔ code and documents on ⛔ one day; ⛔ this is the ⛔ FIRST found in ⛔ GAME DATA.** ⇒ ⭐⭐ **`§23`/`SC-§40` cl. 1 again in a ⛔ new medium: ⛔ THE ARTEFACT A HUMAN READS IS ⛔ NOT THE ARTEFACT THE MACHINE RUNS, and ⛔ nothing goes red when they diverge.**

### SC-§46 ⛔⛔⛔ **A ⛔ COMPOUND CLAIM IS ⛔ NOT ONE CLAIM — ⛔ EACH CLAUSE NEEDS ITS ⛔ OWN EVIDENCE. ⭐ A ⛔ HALF-TRUE SENTENCE ⛔ READS AS VERIFIED, AND ⛔ THAT IS WHY IT ⛔ SURVIVES** (added 2026-09-03, settled by 🧑 **Jonathan's own observation**; ⛔ **the sibling of `SC-§42`** — ⛔ `§42` explains the ⛔ ERROR, ⛔ this one explains the ⛔ SURVIVAL)

> ### ⛔⛔ **`Interface.WarMap` SHIPPED SAYING *"closed by ⛔ right-click ⛔ OR ⛔ Escape."* ⛔ RIGHT-CLICK IS ⛔ FALSE. ⛔ ESCAPE IS ⛔ TRUE. ⇒ ⛔ THREE CAREFUL READERS COULD ⛔ NOT SETTLE IT, AND ⛔ IT REACHED A ⛔ SHIPPED BUILD.**

1. ⛔⛔ **THE MECHANISM, AND IT IS ⛔ A PROPERTY OF ⛔ READERS, ⛔ NOT OF CARELESSNESS: ⛔ ANY READER WHO CHECKS THE ⛔ TRUE HALF ⛔ STOPS THERE.** ⛔ **The sentence returns ⛔ CONFIRMED on the first probe.** ⇒ ⭐ **a compound claim is ⛔ maximally durable at ⛔ exactly the ratio that makes it ⛔ wrong — ⛔ one true clause is enough to ⛔ retire the question.**
2. ✅ **THE RULE:** ⛔ **when a sentence joins clauses with `or` / `and` / a comma list, ⛔ EACH CLAUSE IS A ⛔ SEPARATE ROW WITH ⛔ SEPARATE EVIDENCE.** ⛔ **A verdict of *"verified"* on the sentence is ⛔ INADMISSIBLE — ⛔ verify `A`, ⛔ then verify `B`, ⛔ and ⛔ say which is which.** ⭐ **This applies to ⛔ help text, ⛔ comments, ⛔ handoff claims, ⛔ QA rows, ⛔ law bullets and ⛔ playtest questions ⛔ alike.**
3. ⛔⛔ **AND THE ⛔ REPAIR RULE, ⛔ BECAUSE THE OBVIOUS FIX IS ⛔ WORSE THAN THE DEFECT: ⛔ DELETE ⛔ ONLY THE FALSE CLAUSE.** ⛔ **A reader who learns *"that sentence was wrong"* and deletes the ⛔ WHOLE sentence ⛔ destroys a ⛔ TRUE, ⛔ SHIPPED, ⛔ USER-FACING FACT** — ⭐ **here, that Escape closes the war map, which is a control a player needs.** ⚖️ *⛔ `TASK-870` cut ⛔ only the right-click clause and ⛔ left Escape standing. ⛔ That judgement is now ⛔ CONFIRMED BY MEASUREMENT, and it is the ⛔ model.*
4. ⭐ **WHY IT SITS BESIDE `SC-§42`:** ⛔ **`§42` says a ⛔ HANDLED event is ⛔ not an ⛔ ACTIONED event — ⛔ how the wrong belief was ⛔ FORMED.** ⛔ **`§46` says a ⛔ HALF-TRUE sentence ⛔ reads as verified — ⛔ how it ⛔ SURVIVED three readings.** ⇒ ⛔ **both were settled by the ⛔ same instrument: ⛔ ONE CLICK OF JONATHAN'S.** ⚖️ *⛔ When a fact does ⛔ not live in a file, ⛔ no amount of reading closes it — ⛔ and a compound claim is ⛔ exactly where reading feels like it ⛔ did.*

### SC-§47 ⛔⛔⛔ **AN AUTHOR AUDITING THEIR OWN WORK FINDS DEFECTS OF ⛔ EXECUTION. A ⛔ SECOND READER FINDS DEFECTS OF ⛔ DESCRIPTION. ⛔ NEITHER PASS SUBSTITUTES FOR THE OTHER — ⛔ AND SELF-REPORTING RAISES THE FLOOR WITHOUT ⛔ CLOSING THE GAP** (added 2026-09-03, from `TASK-852` + `qa/TASK-856.md`; ⛔ **the ⛔ FIRST law bought by a task that did ⛔ NOTHING WRONG**)

> ### ⛔⛔ **`TASK-852` REPORTED ⛔ THREE DEFECTS ⛔ AGAINST ITSELF — ⛔ THE STANDARD WE ASK FOR, ⛔ MET IN FULL. ⛔ THE GATE THEN FOUND ⛔ TWO MORE. ⛔ ALL THREE OF HIS WERE ⛔ EXECUTION. ⛔ BOTH OF QA'S WERE ⛔ DESCRIPTION. ⛔ THE SPLIT WAS ⛔ CLEAN, AND IT IS ⛔ NOT A COINCIDENCE.**

1. ⛔⛔ **THE MEASURED EVENT, ⛔ ITEMISED, ⛔ because the ⛔ CATEGORIES are the finding and a summary would ⛔ destroy them:**
   - ⛔ **HIS THREE — ⛔ all ⛔ EXECUTION, ⛔ all ⛔ fixed before shipping:** ⛔ **D-1** a ⛔ TAUTOLOGY (`X == X`) written ⛔ inside the negative control itself, ⛔ incapable of going red · ⛔ **D-2** em dashes inside `TEXT()` where the shipped corpus has ⛔ zero · ⛔ **D-3** a ⛔ GUESSED SYMBOL in his own grep-this table.
   - ⛔ **QA'S TWO — ⛔ both ⛔ DESCRIPTION, ⛔ both with the ⛔ CODE CORRECT:** ⛔ **W-1** a back-pointer in the ⛔ same file (*"Test 9 walks the whole registry"*) made ⛔ FALSE ⛔ by his own diff, ⛔ correctly outside his fence but ⛔ NOT REPORTED · ⛔ **W-2** his §8 counterfactual arithmetic wrong ⛔ on the very line he ⛔ nominated as *"the single most breakable line in my diff"* (⛔ he wrote `Unresolved` would be ⛔ 2; it would be ⛔ 1, `SelfEdges` ⛔ 0, ⛔ because the lambda consults the ⛔ REGISTRY, ⛔ not the local struct).
2. ⛔⛔⭐⭐ **THE MECHANISM, ⛔ AND IT IS ⛔ STRUCTURAL, ⛔ NOT A COMMENT ON ANYONE'S CARE: ⛔ AN AUTHOR AUDITS AGAINST ⛔ THEIR OWN INTENT. ⛔ THAT INSTRUMENT IS ⛔ EXCELLENT AT *"the code does not do what I meant"* AND ⛔ STRUCTURALLY BLIND TO *"my sentence about the code is wrong"* — ⛔ BECAUSE THE SENTENCE ⛔ IS THE INTENT.**
   - ⛔ **You cannot catch a wrong ⛔ DESCRIPTION by ⛔ re-reading it: ⛔ it will agree with what you believe ⛔ every single time.** ⇒ ⛔ **W-2 is the proof — ⛔ he re-read that line ⛔ hard enough to ⛔ nominate it as his most breakable, and ⛔ still mis-described it.**
   - ⛔ **And ⛔ W-1 is the ⛔ other half: a ⛔ CORRECT fence ⛔ prevented him from ⛔ touching the false sentence, and ⛔ nothing in a self-audit ⛔ prompts you to report a defect you were ⛔ forbidden to fix.** ⇒ ⭐ **the fence that made his diff ⛔ safe is the ⛔ same fence that made the defect ⛔ invisible to him.**
3. ✅ **THE RULE, ⛔ IN THREE PARTS:**
   1. ⛔ **A SELF-REPORTED DEFECT LIST IS ⛔ EVIDENCE OF ⛔ DILIGENCE, ⛔ NEVER EVIDENCE OF ⛔ COMPLETENESS.** ⛔ **A gate may ⛔ NOT reduce its scope because the handoff audited itself** — ⛔ *"he found three, so he probably found them all"* is ⛔ exactly the inference this section exists to forbid.
   2. ⛔⛔ **A GATE READING A ⛔ SELF-AUDITED HANDOFF ⛔ SPENDS ITS EFFORT ON ⛔ DESCRIPTION: ⛔ every COUNT, every ⛔ COUNTERFACTUAL, every ⛔ PRESENT-TENSE claim about code, and ⛔ every back-pointer the diff ⛔ MADE STALE.** ⛔ **The author has ⛔ already swept execution ⛔ better than you will.** ⇒ ⭐ **read the ⛔ PROSE against the ⛔ CODE, ⛔ not the code against itself.**
   3. ⭐ **AND THE AUTHOR'S ⛔ ADDED DUTY, ⛔ which is cheap and would have caught ⛔ W-1: ⛔ AFTER YOUR DIFF, ⛔ GREP THE FILES YOU TOUCHED FOR ⛔ PROSE THAT DESCRIBES WHAT YOU JUST MOVED.** ⛔ **A sentence you were ⛔ FENCED OUT of repairing is ⛔ still a sentence you are ⛔ OBLIGED TO REPORT** (`SC-§15`: ⛔ the fence limits the ⛔ REPAIR, ⛔ never the ⛔ REPORT).
4. ⚖️⭐⭐ **WHY THIS IS WORTH A SECTION RATHER THAN A NOTE ON THAT ROW: ⛔ THE OBVIOUS LESSON HERE IS THE ⛔ WRONG ONE.** ⛔ **The tempting read is *"self-reporting did not work"* ⇒ ⛔ stop asking for it. ⛔ THE MEASUREMENT SAYS THE OPPOSITE: ⛔ his three were ⛔ REAL, ⛔ one of them (D-1) would have shipped a ⛔ negative control that ⛔ COULD NOT GO RED — ⛔ the exact defect the task existed to ⛔ remove — and ⛔ NO GATE HAD YET LOOKED.** ⇒ ⛔ **Self-reporting ⛔ RAISED THE FLOOR. ⛔ It did ⛔ not close the gap. ⛔ BOTH PASSES WERE NEEDED, and ⛔ the correct response is to ⛔ keep asking for both.**
   - ⛔ **RELATED, ⛔ NOT DUPLICATED: ⛔ `SC-§38` cl. 8 says the ⛔ SNIPPET IS NORMATIVE · ⛔ `SC-§46` says a ⛔ HALF-TRUE SENTENCE SURVIVES READING · ⛔ THIS says ⛔ WHO CAN SEE WHICH KIND OF DEFECT.** ⇒ ⛔ **`§38` and `§46` describe the ⛔ DEFECT; ⛔ `§47` assigns the ⛔ READER.**
5. 🛡️⛔⛔ **CLAUSE 5 — ⛔ DO ⛔ NOT ABRIDGE THIS SECTION. ⛔ THREE SENTENCES ABOVE ARE THE ⛔ LOAD-BEARING ONES AND A SUMMARY ⛔ DESTROYS ALL THREE** (⛔ added 2026-09-03 in the ⛔ same sitting the section was written, ⛔ because a law about ⛔ descriptions going stale that is itself ⛔ paraphrased later would be ⛔ its own counter-example):
   - ⛔ **(i) THE MECHANISM (cl. 2): *"⛔ You cannot catch a wrong DESCRIPTION by re-reading it — ⛔ it will agree with what you believe every single time."*** ⛔ **`W-2` is its ⛔ PROOF and must ⛔ travel with it: ⛔ the author re-read that line hard enough to ⛔ NOMINATE IT as the ⛔ single most breakable in his diff ⛔ and still mis-described it.** ⛔ **Strip the exhibit and the sentence degrades into ⛔ advice.**

7. ⛔⛔⭐⭐ **CLAUSE 7 — THE ⛔ BARRIER IS ⛔ RE-READING vs ⛔ RE-MEASURING, ⛔ NOT ⛔ AUTHOR vs ⛔ SECOND READER. ⛔ THE VARIABLE WAS ⛔ ISOLATED: ⛔ SAME AUTHOR, ⛔ SAME SENTENCE, ⛔ TWO PASSES — ⛔ RE-READING MISSED IT, ⛔ RE-MEASURING CAUGHT IT** (added 2026-09-03 by `qa/TASK-889.md` loop 2, ⛔ **sharpening cl. 2's framing, which had located the barrier in ⛔ WHO reads**).

   - ⛔⛔⭐⭐ **AND THE ⛔ STRONGEST EXHIBIT THIS SECTION HAS, ⛔ BECAUSE THE ⛔ ENFORCER REPORTED IT ⛔ AGAINST ITSELF: ⛔⛔ A GATE IS ⛔ NOT EXEMPT FROM THE LAW IT IS ⛔ ENFORCING.** ⛔ **`qa/TASK-889.md` loop 2 found ⛔ TWO MORE of this exact shape ⛔ IN ITS ⛔ OWN LOOP-1 VERDICT:** ⛔ **(i)** it had described `BoardWithinRosterCap`'s `SetNum` as ⛔ **UNCONDITIONAL** when it is ⛔ **CONDITIONAL** — ⛔ a load-bearing distinction · ⛔ **(ii)** ⛔ **`NIT-2` was ⛔ SIMPLY WRONG and is ⛔ WITHDRAWN, ⛔ NOT DECLINED**: `FindNameArrayField`'s non-const return is ⛔ **LOAD-BEARING at 4 write sites** and the ⛔ **1 read-only site ⛔ ALREADY binds `const`** ⇒ ⛔ **the programmer's refusal was ⛔ CORRECT.**

### SC-§48 ⛔⛔⛔ **A CLAMP WRITTEN FOR ⛔ RANGE SAFETY SILENTLY ⛔ LAUNDERS `NaN` INTO THE ⛔ SAFE VALUE — ⛔ AND THE "SAFE" END IS THE ⛔ PERMISSIVE ONE BY ⛔ CONSTRUCTION, ⛔ NOT BY ANYONE'S CHOICE** (added 2026-09-03; found by `TASK-871` reading the ⛔ ARITHMETIC, confirmed at ⛔ TWO ENGINE SITES by `qa/TASK-914.md`; ⛔ nothing in either spec mentioned it)

> ### ⛔⛔ **THE SHIPPED SLOPE GATE ⛔ FAILED OPEN ON A `NaN` NORMAL: A ⛔ GARBAGE SURFACE READ AS ⛔ PERFECTLY FLAT AND WAS ⛔ ADMITTED. ⛔ THE IDIOM THAT DID IT IS ⛔ EVERYWHERE.**

1. ⛔⛔ **THE MECHANISM, ⛔ MEASURED AT SOURCE — ⛔ TWO SITES, ⛔ NOT ONE, AND THAT IS THE ⛔ POINT:**
   ```cpp
   GenericPlatformMath.h:534    Acos(V)  = acos( (V < -1.0) ? -1.0 : ((V < 1.0) ? V : 1.0) )
   UnrealMathUtility.h:592-595  Clamp(X) = Max( Min(X, MaxValue), MinValue )
   ```
   - ⛔ **EVERY comparison against `NaN` is ⛔ FALSE.** ⇒ ⛔ **both idioms fall through to their ⛔ FINAL branch ⇒ ⛔ `1.0` ⇒ ⛔ `acos(1.0) = 0` ⇒ ⛔ a `NaN` normal reported as ⛔ ZERO DEGREES OF SLOPE.**
   - ⛔⛔⭐⭐ **AND THE ⛔ SHIPPED LINE LAUNDERED IT ⛔ TWICE OVER: `Acos(Clamp(NormalZ, -1, 1))` ⇒ ⛔ REMOVING ⛔ EITHER CLAMP WOULD ⛔ NOT HAVE SAVED IT.** ⇒ ⛔ **defence in depth ⛔ made it worse: ⛔ two independent guards, ⛔ the same blind spot, ⛔ zero warning.**
2. ⛔⛔⭐⭐ **WHY IT IS A ⛔ PROPERTY OF THE IDIOM AND ⛔ NOT OF ANYONE'S JUDGEMENT — ⛔ THIS IS THE HALF TO KEEP: ⛔ THE CLAMP'S ⛔ FINAL BRANCH IS ⛔ BY CONSTRUCTION THE ⛔ BENIGN END, AND ⛔ THE AUTHOR NEVER CHOSE THAT DIRECTION.**
   - ⛔ **A clamp is written to answer *"⛔ keep this in range"*. ⛔ Nobody writing one is ⛔ deciding what a ⛔ non-number should mean** — ⛔ yet the ⛔ fall-through ⛔ silently makes that decision, and it makes it in the ⛔ PERMISSIVE direction ⛔ every time.
   - ⚖️ *⛔ Same family as the ⛔ empty-log-reads-as-a-zero-offset law and `SC-§44`: ⛔ THE FAILURE LIES IN THE ⛔ REASSURING DIRECTION. ⛔ A gate that refuses too much gets ⛔ reported in a minute; ⛔ a gate that admits garbage gets ⛔ reported never.*
3. ✅ **THE RULE, ⛔ AND IT IS ⛔ ORDERING, ⛔ NOT VIGILANCE: ⛔ TEST THE ⛔ NON-FINITE INPUT ⛔ BEFORE THE CLAMP. ⛔ NEVER RELY ON ⛔ COMPARISON SEMANTICS TO REFUSE IT.**
   - ⛔ **`FMath::IsFinite(X)` (or `IsNaN`) goes ⛔ FIRST, on the ⛔ RAW value, with an ⛔ EXPLICIT refusal branch.** ⛔ **A clamp ⛔ downstream of that test is fine; a clamp ⛔ standing in for it is a ⛔ fail-open.**
   - ⛔ **The refusal must be the ⛔ CONSERVATIVE end, ⛔ named out loud** (⛔ here: `180°` ⇒ ⛔ refuse). ⛔ **Do ⛔ not let the compiler pick.**
4. ⛔ **WHERE TO LOOK — ⛔ this is ⛔ not a one-site defect:** ⛔ **any `Acos`/`Asin` fed a dot product · any `Clamp` on a value that ⛔ came from a trace, a normal, a division, or a `Normalize()` that could have divided by zero · any `FMath::Max(Min(...))` guarding a ⛔ threshold comparison.** ⛔ **A `NaN` reaching any of these is ⛔ admitted, ⛔ silently.**
5. ⚖️ **HOW IT WAS FOUND, ⛔ recorded because it bears on ⛔ what reviews are for: ⛔ by reading the ⛔ ARITHMETIC, ⛔ not the spec, and ⛔ not by any name census** (`SC-§41`'s instruments are ⛔ blind here — ⛔ NOTHING IS MISNAMED). ⭐ **It is also `SC-§40` cl. 1's shape: the task was boarded to ⛔ widen a probe, and the ⛔ defect it found was in the ⛔ line it had to read on the way.**

### SC-§49 ⛔⛔⛔ **A CENSUS IS ⛔ PUBLISHED UNDER THE ⛔ SAME PREDICATE IT WAS ⛔ MEASURED UNDER — ⛔ QUOTED FROM THE SPEC, ⛔ NOT RESTATED IN TIDIER WORDS. ⭐ RE-SCOPING ON THE WAY OUT IS HOW A ⛔ CORRECT MEASUREMENT BECOMES A ⛔ FALSE CLAIM** (added 2026-09-03; ⛔ proposed by `qa/TASK-934.md` `W-1` + note 4, ⛔ written by the manager; ⛔ **the number was RIGHT, the census was RUN, the positive control EXISTED — and the ⛔ published sentence is still ⛔ FALSE**)

> ### ⚖️⭐⭐ **THE OTHER LAWS IN THIS FAMILY POLICE A ⛔ MEASUREMENT THAT WAS ⛔ NEVER TAKEN. ⛔ THIS ONE POLICES A ⛔ MEASUREMENT THAT WAS TAKEN ⛔ CORRECTLY AND THEN ⛔ DESCRIBED AT A ⛔ WIDER SCOPE THAN IT COVERS.**

1. ⛔⛔ **THE MEASURED EVENT, ⛔ and its smallness is the point.** A row specified a needle census under an ⛔ explicit predicate: *"⛔ any needle carrying a ⛔ TRAILING SPACE, a ⛔ TRAILING `//`, or ⛔ any character whose presence depends on a ⛔ COMMENT rather than on ⛔ CODE."* ⛔ **The sweep was run over ⛔ all 21 `.Find(TEXT(` needles in the file, ⛔ correctly, ⛔ with a positive control ⇒ ⛔ answer: ⛔ ONE.** ✅ **A gate re-ran it independently and ⛔ CONFIRMED both the ⛔ 21 and the ⛔ 1.**
   - ⛔⛔ **THE RESULT WAS THEN ⛔ PUBLISHED — ⛔ in the shipped comment ⛔ AND on the board — as: *"⛔ it was the ⛔ ONLY ONE not ending at a ⛔ SYNTACTIC TERMINATOR."*** ⛔ **Under ⛔ THAT predicate the answer is ⛔ TWO: `Find(TEXT("FireProjectileAt(Target"))` is an ⛔ ORDERING needle ending on an ⛔ IDENTIFIER FRAGMENT, ⛔ 2,192 lines above the sentence denying it exists.**
   - ⇒ ⚖️ ***⛔ THE MEASUREMENT WAS RIGHT AND THE PUBLISHED SENTENCE IS WRONG, ⛔ BECAUSE IT WAS ⛔ RE-SCOPED ON THE WAY OUT.***
2. ⛔⛔⭐⭐ **WHY IT IS ⛔ ITS OWN SECTION AND ⛔ NOT AN INSTANCE OF SOMETHING WE ALREADY HAVE — ⛔ THREE NEIGHBOURS, ⛔ ALL DIFFERENT:**
   - ⛔ **NOT a ⛔ STALE description** (`SC-§39.1` cl. 7's present-tense prose): ⛔ **it was ⛔ NEVER TRUE, ⛔ not even at the instant it was written.** ⛔ Nothing drifted.
   - ⛔ **NOT an ⛔ ANTICIPATORY description** (`SC-§39.1` cl. 9): ⛔ **it describes the ⛔ PRESENT, ⛔ not a future state.** ⛔ Nothing was promised.
   - ⛔ **NOT `SC-§40` cl. 1's ⛔ UNMEASURED ABSENCE: ⛔ THE MEASUREMENT ⛔ HAPPENED. ⛔ The author ⛔ did the work, ⛔ did it right, and ⛔ carried a positive control.** ⇒ ⛔⛔ **EVERY EXISTING DETECTOR ⛔ PASSES THIS DEFECT, ⛔ which is precisely why it needs its ⛔ own name.**
3. ⛔⛔ **WHY IT IS ⛔ EXPENSIVE DESPITE FAILING ⛔ NOTHING: ⛔ THE PUBLISHED SENTENCE IS ⛔ WHAT THE NEXT READER ⛔ INHERITS, and a ⛔ universal claim is a ⛔ GUARD THAT SUPPRESSES THE ⛔ NEXT CENSUS.** ⛔ *"Every other needle in this file is already safe"* tells the next reader ⛔ not to look — ⛔ **in a file whose ⛔ entire method is census.** ⇒ ⛔ **the ⛔ cost is ⛔ not the wrong sentence; it is the ⛔ SWEEP THAT NOW NEVER HAPPENS.**
4. ✅ **THE RULE, ⛔ and it is ⛔ mechanical rather than ⛔ attentive:**
   - ⛔ **(a) ⛔ QUOTE THE PREDICATE ⛔ VERBATIM FROM THE SPEC IN THE SAME SENTENCE AS THE NUMBER.** ⛔ *"`N` needles carry ⛔ &lt;predicate as written&gt;"* — ⛔ never a ⛔ paraphrase, ⛔ however obviously equivalent it seems. ⛔ **The paraphrase ⛔ is the defect.**
   - ⛔ **(b) ⛔ IF A ⛔ BROADER OR TIDIER CLAIM IS ⛔ WORTH MAKING, ⛔ IT IS A ⛔ SECOND MEASUREMENT.** ⛔ **Re-run at the ⛔ new scope, ⛔ publish ⛔ both numbers, ⛔ or ⛔ do not make it.** ⛔ **A wider claim is ⛔ never free — ⛔ it is ⛔ always a bigger search.**
   - ⛔ **(c) ⛔ BE ⛔ SUSPICIOUS OF ⛔ EVERY UNIVERSAL (*"every"*, *"the only"*, *"all other"*, *"none of"*): ⛔ a universal over a corpus you ⛔ enumerated is ⛔ cheap to state and ⛔ cheap to ⛔ REFUTE, ⛔ so ⛔ list the corpus beside it** (⭐ `SC-§40` cl. 11(b)'s ⛔ name-the-symbol rule, ⛔ turned on a ⛔ PRESENCE claim instead of an ⛔ ABSENCE one). ⭐ **The gate that found this listed ⛔ all 21 with their ⛔ terminating characters — ⛔ which is ⛔ why its own claim is cheap to check.**
5. ⛔⛔ **AND THE ⛔ PROPAGATION RULE, ⛔ because this one had ⛔ already travelled: ⛔ THE ⛔ SAME WRONG SENTENCE WAS IN ⛔ TWO PLACES — the ⛔ shipped comment ⛔ AND the ⛔ board's `status:` block, ⛔ which was the ⛔ ONLY board-side record of an ⛔ out-of-band delivery.** ⇒ ⛔ **when a re-scoped claim is found, ⛔ CORRECT ⛔ EVERY COPY, ⛔ and correct the ⛔ RECORD before the ⛔ COMMENT.** ⚖️ ***⛔ A WRONG SENTENCE IN THE ⛔ SOLE RECORD IS ⛔ WORSE THAN A WRONG SENTENCE IN A ⛔ COMMENT.***
6. ⭐ **THE COMPANION FINDING, ⛔ kept beside the rule because it is the ⛔ reusable half: ⛔ the counterexample needle (`FireProjectileAt(Target`) buys ⛔ ZERO discrimination — ⛔ measured ⛔ ONE occurrence in the extracted body — while ⛔ costing a dependence on an ⛔ argument name and on the call ⛔ not being line-wrapped.** ⛔ **It fails ⛔ CLOSED, so it is ⛔ not urgent** (`SC-§41`). ⛔ **Recorded so nobody re-derives it, and ⛔ so nobody "fixes" it by ⛔ widening the false universal instead of ⛔ narrowing it.**

## Damage types (C++)
- UDamageType subclasses named `USiegeDamageType_<Kind>`, all declared in `Source/GitClaudeUnrealTest/Siegebound/DamageTypes.h/.cpp`
- Kinds: `Melee`, `Projectile`, `Siege` (**added M4, TASK-054**), `Spell` (**added M5, TASK-098**)
- Damage-vs-fortification scaling (GDD §3.0) reads `DamageEvent.DamageTypeClass`: Projectile = 50%, Melee/default = 100%, **`Siege` = 200%**. **M4 ruling:** the 200% applies to BOTH the castle (`ACastle::TakeDamage`) AND buildings (`ABuilding::TakeDamage`) — Siege units (Profile=Siege: Ogre, Sapper) tag their attacks with `USiegeDamageType_Siege`. Units and the hero always take the listed damage (no scaling). Attackers tag projectile/siege damage; melee needs no tag.
- **M5 ruling — `Spell` = 50% in `ACastle::TakeDamage` ONLY** (mirrors the M2 Projectile precedent, NOT the M4 Siege both-rule): buildings/units/hero take FULL listed spell damage — Lightning (200) must kill an Arrow Tower (150 HP), it is "the tower-killer" per GDD §4. All spell damage is applied with `USiegeDamageType_Spell`.

## Spells & Set III (M5)
Added 2026-07-08 (TASK-097..109; GDD §3.5/§3.11/§4 Set III/§7). Spells have NO actor blueprints — they resolve through code (see resolver). Crystal Tower is a normal building card (existing `BP_Building_<CardID>` / `SM_<CardID>` laws apply: `BP_Building_CrystalTower`, `SM_CrystalTower`; card art `T_CardArt_<CardID>` law applies to all 6 new CardIDs).
- **Set III CardIDs (row names, character-for-character):** `Fireball`, `FrostNova`, `Lightning`, `BattleCry`, `Pickpocket`, `CrystalTower`.
- **Spell resolver:** `USpellLibrary` (UBlueprintFunctionLibrary) in `Source/GitClaudeUnrealTest/Siegebound/SpellLibrary.h/.cpp` — the ONE home for spell resolution, shared by `ASiegePlayerController` (targeting mode) and `ASiegeBotController` (M5 bot rules). Entry point pinned: `static bool USpellLibrary::ResolveSpell(UWorld* World, FName CardID, const FCardRow& Row, ETeamId CasterTeam, const FVector& TargetPoint)`. Null-safe everywhere; no friendly fire (§3.0).
- **FCardRow M5 columns (typed one-per-concept, sparse; registry continues the M4 list):**
  - `SpellEffect` (`ESpellEffect` enum, `None`) — dispatch token: `None` / `AoEDamage` (Fireball) / `Freeze` (FrostNova) / `TopTargetsDamage` (Lightning) / `AllyBuff` (BattleCry) / `GoldSteal` (Pickpocket). Declared in CardRow.h. CSV cells use the enum value names.
  - `EffectDuration` (float, 0) — timed-effect seconds (FrostNova 4, BattleCry 8).
  - `MaxTargets` (int32, 0) — top-N target count (Lightning 3).
  - `GoldSteal` (int32, 0) — gold stolen, capped at what the victim has (Pickpocket 10).
  - `ChainTargets` (int32, 0) — Chain keyword arrives as its typed column per the M4 deferral note: total targets hit per attack (CrystalTower 3).
  - `ChainFalloff` (int32, 0) — flat damage reduction per bounce (CrystalTower 5 ⇒ 15/10/5 with Dmg 15).
  - Spells REUSE `Damage` (Fireball 100, Lightning 200) and `AoERadius` (Fireball 300, FrostNova 350, Lightning 400, BattleCry 400) — no duplicate radius/damage columns.
- **Mechanic rules (UPROPERTY defaults with GDD § comments, NOT CSV — M2/M4 precedent, e.g. Rally/Charge magnitudes):** BattleCry magnitudes (+50% attack speed, +25% move speed), `ChainBounceRadius` = 350 (bounce search radius from the previous target — GDD doesn't specify; manager-defined), freeze non-stacking refresh rule.
- **Targeting mode (§3.5/§7):** spells target ANYWHERE on the map (no half restriction); the ground reticle is TRACE-projected onto whatever surface is under the cursor (terrain-ready for M4.5 hills — LAW, not a follow-up); LMB confirms (gold deducted at confirm — card-leaves-hand-at-CONFIRM law), RMB/Esc cancels free. **Exception (manager ruling):** `GoldSteal` spells resolve INSTANTLY on play (no reticle for a global effect — recorded deviation from §3.5; CardType stays Spell).
- **Spell VFX (code contract):** every spell resolve spawns `/Game/VFX/NS_Spell_<CardID>` (Niagara, Content/VFX/), soft path COMPOSED from the CardID (mirrors the BP soft-class-path law), null-safe: missing system ⇒ log once, resolve anyway. Crystal Tower's chain visual is `/Game/VFX/NS_ChainZap`. Donor-duplicate authoring from Variant_Combat Niagara systems is acceptable at M5 (template-donor rule); §6 one-frame readability bar.
- **Targeting reticle material:** `M_SpellReticle` (Content/Materials/, DeferredDecal domain — M_CenterlineStripe recipe), soft-referenced by the targeting-mode code, null-safe (missing ⇒ no visual, targeting still works, log once).
- **Spell VFX element re-skin (M7, TASK-187):** the fire/ice spell systems are RE-SKINNED to the imported `Content/Fire_Magic/` + `Content/Ice_Magic/` Niagara packs AT THEIR EXISTING code-contract paths — `/Game/VFX/NS_Spell_Fireball` (← `Fire_Magic/VFX_Niagara/NS_Fire_Magic_Explosion` or `_AOE`) and `/Game/VFX/NS_Spell_FrostNova` (← `Ice_Magic/VFX_Niagara/NS_Ice_Magic_Shockwave`/`_Frozen`/`_Snowstorm`). **NO rename, NO new data column:** `USpellLibrary::ResolveSpell` COMPOSES the path from the CardID (SpellLibrary.cpp:77-78), so the re-skin MUST land at these exact placeholder paths (a data column cannot point at a `Fire_Magic` asset). This is a VFX LOOK-SWAP, NOT a new card — Fireball (cards.csv row 24, `DeckCount 2`, in deck) + FrostNova (row 25, `DeckCount 0`, NOT in the default deck — see flag) already exist from M5.

## Material & Niagara lane laws
- **Custom-HLSL BAN (codified 2026-07-22 from TASK-245; previously lived only in orchestrator memory + the TASK-239 handoff):** NEVER use a Custom HLSL node in materials on this project — under the Substrate + HW-RT stack it detonates shader permutations and wedges the editor (TASK-239: 0-for-2, ~4 h lost; the stock-node rebuild compiles in seconds — TASK-245 proof). STOCK NODES + PARAMETERS ONLY; parameter iteration never recompiles. Evidence: handoffs/TASK-239.md.
- **UE 5.8 Niagara/material lane notes (pointer):** three engine findings from the TASK-245 session — the sprite-VF TexCoord bug, per-instance ObjectPositionWS behavior, and the dead attributeBindings lane — are documented in `handoffs/TASK-239.md` (FINAL SESSION). Read before authoring sprite-based Niagara or per-instance material logic.
- **Instanced-mesh material flag law (codified 2026-07-22, TASK-249):** any material consumed via `FScatterLayer.OverrideMaterial` (or ANY runtime HISM `SetMaterial`) MUST set `bUsedWithInstancedStaticMeshes=true` — without it the HISM silently renders the gray WorldGridMaterial default. TASK-249 evidence: the first wired seed rendered gray with `OverrideMaterials[0]` correctly set; the flag fixed it. Evidence: handoffs/TASK-249.md.

### ⛔⛔ NIAGARA INERTNESS — THREE FINDINGS, ONE OF THEM A LIVE CONTENT DEFECT (added 2026-09-01; TASK-747 · `qa/TASK-753.md` W-5 · TASK-759)

- ⛔⛔ **A NIAGARA SYSTEM DUPLICATED VIA MCP / `EditorAssetLibrary` IS ***SILENTLY INERT*** — AND ⛔ NO HASH, STATE OR PROPERTY CHECK CAN DETECT IT. ⭐ ONLY PIXELS CAN.** It loads, reports the correct class, resolves the correct dependencies, spawns a component that reports ⛔ no error — and renders **nothing**. ⚠️⚠️ **`is_active()` and `is_visible()` return `true` for the inert duplicate too ⇒ a state readback proves ⛔ NOTHING.** ✅ **The repair is opening it ONCE in the Niagara editor** (that is what triggers the compile), then an **EXPLICIT single-path save**. ⛔⛔ **AND THE `.uasset` BYTES ARE ***UNCHANGED*** BY THE REPAIR** — measured `a082d797…` before and after ⇒ **the compiled data is DDC-side, ⛔ not package-side** ⇒ ⛔ **a sha / mtime / `git status` check cannot tell a working system from a dead one.** ⇒ ⛔ **EVERY NEW `NS_` DUPLICATE IS CONFIRMED ON PIXELS AT INTEGRATION** (`AS-§6 A(e)`, `SHIP-§9c`), ⛔ never on a readback. ✅ **Done correctly for `NS_RecallChannel` at TASK-742 — proven on pixels in PIE, explicitly ⛔ not on `is_active()`.**
- ⛔⛔ **`NS_CastleDebris` IS INERT — AND THE DUPLICATION IDIOM IS ⛔ ***EXONERATED*** FOR IT: ITS DONOR `NS_Damage` RENDERS NOTHING EITHER.** Measured with a **calibrated three-way control in one frame** (TASK-759): CONTROL `NS_Fire_Magic_Orb` `active:true` at **every** age with real bounds `262/164/164`; **DONOR `NS_Damage` and SUBJECT `NS_CastleDebris` both `active:false` at EVERY age** (0.02 · 0.1 · 0.3 · 0.6 · 1.2 · 2.5 · 5.0) with **identical degenerate bounds `244/128/128`**; **pixels agree** (`handoffs/TASK-759-C`). ⭐⭐ **THE DECISIVE STEP: opening it in the Niagara editor — the repair for the duplication defect — did ⛔ NOT revive it.** ⇒ **`Castle.cpp:1394` has ALWAYS burst an empty system at every crumble threshold** (and `:1393`'s *"null-safe until `NS_CastleDebris` lands"* is stale — it landed, and it is empty). ⚖️ **A live CONTENT defect, ⛔ unrelated to the recall/ghost features** — boarded as **`TASK-768`**.
- ⚠️⚠️ **AND THE READING THAT MUST ⛔ NOT BE OVER-READ, BECAUSE IT ALREADY WAS ONCE: *"DEAD AT SYSTEM AGE 10.0"* IS A ***CHANNEL-SURVIVAL*** MEASUREMENT, ⛔ NOT A RENDER TEST.** TASK-747/759's age-10.0 sweep existed to find an effect **still running when a 10-second channel ends**; ⭐ **a one-shot burst that has correctly finished by then reads `active:false` BY DESIGN.** ⇒ ⛔ **the five `/Game/VFX/NS_Spell_*` and `NS_ChainZap` reading `false` at 10.0 is ⛔ NOT evidence that they render nothing** — and `handoffs/TASK-238.md` records `NS_Spell_Fireball` + `NS_Spell_FrostNova` **PIE-verified at the gameplay camera**, which is the stronger evidence and points the other way. ✅ **The only admissible verdict is the CALIBRATED MULTI-AGE sweep TASK-759 used on `NS_CastleDebris`** — a known-good control in the same frame, ages spanning the effect's **own** lifetime, and pixels. ⛔⛔ **Nobody writes *"the spell VFX are dead"* into law, a spec, a handoff or a Slack post until that sweep says so (`TASK-768`).** ⚖️ *An instrument aimed at one question does not get to answer a different one — `SHIP-§9`'s class, pointed at ourselves a second time.*
- 📌 **`FAB-008` is the standing answer for a purpose-built looping channel effect:** the project owns **no** effect authored to last a channel — 20 systems staged and age-scrubbed, **only 5 survive 10.0 s**, and 3 of those are opaque ice-shard meshes disqualified on pixels.

## Textured mesh law (TRELLIS.2 art pipeline)
Added 2026-07-07 (TASK-082..088, Jonathan-approved plan: automated TRELLIS.2 → Blender → UE5 pipeline). Governs game-ready textured meshes produced by `Tools/ArtPipeline/` (pilot scope: Footman, Archer, Castle; the remaining M7 blockouts follow this template). `<AssetName>` = CardID for card actors, `Castle` for the castle.
